Chapter 12 / 17 · Week 5第 12 / 17 章 · 第 5 周

Autoencoders and variational autoencoders自编码器与变分自编码器

Lecture deck: 对应课件：5a_Autoencoders.pdf · 29 slides29 页
Jump to chapter practice ↓跳到本章练习 ↓

Generative models, autoencoders & regularization生成模型、自编码器与正则化

Generative models estimate data distribution and sample new observations; a Gaussian estimates mean/variance, mixture of Gaussians combines components. Autoencoder encodes x to latent z, decodes reconstruction x̂; bottleneck learns compact representation, but deterministic AE does not guarantee sampleable latent distribution.

Pretraining uses reconstruction then transfers encoder. Sparse AE penalizes activation sparsity, contractive AE penalizes encoder sensitivity (Jacobian), denoising AE reconstructs clean input from corrupted input. Decoder may upsample using transposed convolution (DC-GAN-style architecture).

生成模型估计数据分布并采样新数据；高斯估计均值/方差，混合高斯组合多个成分。自编码器编码 x 为隐变量 z，解码重构 x̂；瓶颈学习紧凑表示，但确定性 AE 不保证隐空间可直接采样。预训练先重构再迁移编码器。稀疏 AE 惩罚激活密度，收缩 AE 惩罚编码器敏感度（Jacobian），去噪 AE 从污染输入重构干净输入。解码器可用转置卷积上采样（DC-GAN 类架构）。

Key equation核心公式

Start with an explicit generative distribution: estimate sample mean μ and covariance Σ, draw ε~N(0,I), then x=μ+Σ¹ᐟ²ε. A mixture of Gaussians combines several component densities with mixture weights, allowing multiple modes. A discriminative classifier estimates p(y|x); a generative model estimates p(x) or p(x,y).

An autoencoder learns reconstruction x̂=g(f(x)). A bottleneck forces compression; with linear layers and squared error the learned subspace relates to PCA, while nonlinear layers can learn curved manifolds. Convolutional encoders and fractional-strided/transposed convolutions can handle image reconstruction.

After unsupervised pretraining, discard the decoder and attach a classification head. Sparse AE discourages many active units (e.g. activation penalty), contractive AE penalizes the encoder Jacobian norm, and denoising AE maps a corrupted input back to the clean target. An unconstrained overcomplete AE may copy input without learning useful structure.

For pixel values and a Gaussian decoder, squared error corresponds to negative log likelihood; Bernoulli outputs motivate cross entropy.

先从显式生成分布出发：估计样本均值 μ 和协方差 Σ，抽取 ε~N(0,I)，再 x=μ+Σ¹ᐟ²ε。高斯混合用混合权重组合多个分量密度，能表达多峰。判别分类器估计 p(y|x)，生成模型估计 p(x) 或 p(x,y)。AE 学习重构 x̂=g(f(x))。瓶颈强制压缩；线性层和平方误差的子空间与 PCA 有关，非线性可学习弯曲流形。卷积编码器与分数步幅/转置卷积可重构图像。

无监督预训练后去掉解码器、添加分类头。稀疏 AE 惩罚过多激活单元；收缩 AE 惩罚编码器 Jacobian 范数；去噪 AE 从损坏输入恢复干净目标。无约束过完备 AE 可能直接复制输入，未学习有用结构。高斯解码器对应平方误差负对数似然，Bernoulli 输出对应交叉熵。

An autoencoder has two learned mappings: encoder compresses input into a code, and decoder tries to reconstruct the original. It needs no external class label because x itself supplies the reconstruction target. A bottleneck discourages a trivial identity mapping, while sparsity or corruption can constrain a larger code.

For denoising, noisy x is the input and clean x is the target; training to reproduce noisy x would teach the wrong objective. A deterministic AE may reconstruct well but give arbitrary outputs for random latent vectors far from learned codes.

自编码器有两个学习映射：编码器将输入压缩为编码，解码器重建原输入。无需外部类别标签，因为 x 自身就是重建目标。瓶颈抑制平凡恒等映射，稀疏或扰动也可约束更大编码。去噪 AE 以带噪 x 为输入、干净 x 为目标；若重建噪声输入，目标就错了。确定性 AE 可能重建优秀，却对远离学习编码的随机潜向量产生无意义输出。

Variational autoencoder (VAE)变分自编码器（VAE）

Stochastic encoder qφ(z|x) outputs Gaussian mean and variance; decoder pθ(x|z) models likelihood. Sample via reparameterization z=μ+σ⊙ε, ε~N(0,I), so gradients can flow through μ and σ. Optimize reconstruction negative log likelihood plus KL to standard-normal prior; equivalently maximize ELBO.

KL regularizes latent space for generation; too strong may reduce reconstruction fidelity. Generate by sampling prior then decoding. Wasserstein autoencoder (WAE) uses distribution matching with a different regularization perspective.

随机编码器 qφ(z|x) 输出高斯均值、方差；解码器 pθ(x|z) 建模似然。重参数化 z=μ+σ⊙ε，ε~N(0,I)，让梯度通过 μ、σ。优化重构负对数似然加标准正态先验 KL，等价最大化 ELBO。KL 规范隐空间以生成，过强可能降低重构质量。从先验采样后解码即可生成。Wasserstein 自编码器（WAE）采用不同的分布匹配正则思路。

Key equation核心公式
The second expression is KL for a diagonal Gaussian posterior against a standard normal prior. The first term is a reconstruction negative log-likelihood.第二式为对角高斯后验相对标准正态先验的 KL；第一项为重建负对数似然。

A deterministic AE does not specify a prior distribution over codes, so random latent vectors may fall in gaps. A VAE uses qφ(z|x) to approximate an intractable posterior and pθ(x|z) as decoder. Maximize ELBO=E_q[ln pθ(x|z)]−KL(qφ(z|x)||p(z)); negative ELBO is the minimized loss. For diagonal Gaussian q and unit normal prior, KL=½Σ(μⱼ²+σⱼ²−1−ln σⱼ²).

If μ=2, σ²=1 in one dimension, KL=2. Reparameterize as z=μ+σ⊙ε to separate randomness from differentiable parameters. If KL dominates too much, the code may ignore the input (posterior collapse); too little yields poorly structured latent space.

Sampling z from the prior and decoding creates examples; interpolating digits/faces can show learned factors, but individual directions are not guaranteed disentangled. The lecture relates VAEs to modern latent generative modeling and discusses KL/Wasserstein differences.

确定性 AE 没规定编码先验，随机隐变量可能落在空隙中。VAE 用 qφ(z|x) 近似难求的后验，pθ(x|z) 为解码器。最大化 ELBO=E_q[ln pθ(x|z)]−KL(qφ(z|x)||p(z))，最小化其负值。对角高斯 q 与标准正态先验的 KL=½Σ(μⱼ²+σⱼ²−1−ln σⱼ²)。一维 μ=2、σ²=1 时 KL=2。重参数化 z=μ+σ⊙ε 将随机性与可微参数分离。

KL 过强会使编码忽略输入（后验坍塌），太弱则隐空间结构欠佳。从先验采样并解码生成新样本；数字/人脸插值可展示学习因素，但不保证方向相互独立。课件将 VAE 联系现代隐空间生成模型，并讨论 KL/Wasserstein 差异。

The VAE encoder predicts a distribution, not a single point: a mean and variance for each latent coordinate. Sample standard normal noise and set z=μ+σε, so gradients can reach both encoder outputs. The reconstruction term rewards keeping information about x; the KL term penalizes posterior distributions that differ greatly from the prior.

For one latent coordinate with μ=1 and σ=1, KL to N(0,1) equals 0.5 nat. Sampling from the prior at generation time makes sense because the regularizer trains the latent space to be compatible with it.

VAE 编码器预测分布而非单点：每个潜变量的均值与方差。采标准正态噪声并令 z=μ+σε，梯度就能传到两个编码器输出。重建项奖励保存 x 的信息，KL 项惩罚偏离先验的后验。单个潜坐标 μ=1、σ=1 时，对 N(0,1) 的 KL 为 0.5 nat。

生成时从先验采样是合理的，因为正则项训练潜空间与先验兼容。

Chapter practice本章练习

Sample-format practice is the default: one best answer, short written responses, numerical entry tables and diagram choices. Switch to Advanced or All for additional multi-select, code and derivation practice.默认样卷题型：最佳单选、简答、数值输入表格和图形选择。切换进阶或全部可练额外多选、代码与推导。

Open practice questions展开练习题 ·
Format verified against COMP9444 26T3 Sample Examination, pp. 2–8. All questions here are newly authored practice. Sample states final question count/types may vary; numerical tolerance generally ±0.005.题型依据 COMP9444 26T3 Sample Examination 第 2–8 页核对。此处均为新编模拟题。样卷说明正式卷题数/类型可能变化；一般数值容差 ±0.005。
Advanced practice进阶练习
Short answer · 3 marks简答题 · 3 分
E1.A standard autoencoder reconstructs images well but samples from random latent vectors are poor. Explain why, how a VAE addresses it, and one application of an autoencoder.普通自编码器图像重建好，但随机潜向量生成效果差。解释原因、VAE 如何解决，以及自编码器一项应用。
1 mark: deterministic AE reconstruction alone imposes no prior-compatible latent distribution.
1 mark: VAE learns a latent posterior, penalizes KL to a prior and samples via reparameterization.
1 mark: denoising, compression/representation, anomaly detection using reconstruction error, or valid example with explanation.1 分：确定性 AE 仅重建，不保证潜分布兼容先验。
1 分：VAE 学习潜后验，以 KL 约束先验并重参数采样。
1 分：去噪、压缩/表示、重建误差异常检测等一个有效应用及解释。
Numerical answer数值填空
A1.For q(z|x)=N(1,1), prior p(z)=N(0,1), compute KL(q‖p) in nats.q(z|x)=N(1,1)，先验 p(z)=N(0,1)，求 KL(q‖p)，单位 nats。
KL=½(μ²+σ²−ln σ²−1)=½(1+1−0−1)=0.5.KL=½(μ²+σ²−ln σ²−1)=0.5。
Derivation / proof推导 / 证明 · 5 marks5 分
A2.Write the VAE ELBO and the reparameterization for a diagonal Gaussian encoder. Explain the roles of both terms and why directly treating a random sample as independent of encoder parameters would be problematic.写出 VAE ELBO 与对角高斯编码器的重参数化。解释两项作用，以及为何不能把随机样本直接视为与编码器参数无关。
[5 marks] ELBO=E_q[log pθ(x|z)]−KL(qφ(z|x)‖p(z)). Maximize reconstruction likelihood while regularizing latent distribution toward prior. z=μ+σ⊙ε, ε~N(0,I); this expresses randomness through ε independent of φ, allowing gradients through μ and σ. Detaching z would block that reconstruction gradient.[5 分] ELBO=E_q[log pθ(x|z)]−KL(qφ(z|x)‖p(z))。最大化重建似然并将潜在分布正则至先验。z=μ+σ⊙ε，ε~N(0,I)；随机性由与 φ 无关的 ε 提供，可沿 μ、σ 反传。若 detach z 则阻断重建梯度。
Multiple select多选题
A3.An autoencoder reconstructs training samples almost perfectly but arbitrary latent points decode poorly. Which explanations/interventions are sound? Select all.自编码器几乎完美重建训练样本，但任意潜变量点解码很差。哪些解释或措施合理？多选。
Select every correct option. More than one is correct.选择所有正确选项，答案不止一个。
A. Incorrect错误 Plain reconstruction imposes no such distribution constraint.普通重建没有这种分布约束。
B. Correct正确 KL connects the posterior to the chosen prior.KL 将后验与所选先验联系。
C. Correct正确 This encourages useful robust representations, not necessarily a known prior.这鼓励鲁棒表示，但不必然规定先验。
D. Incorrect错误 Capacity does not enforce latent density.容量不约束潜变量密度。
Multi-step calculation多步计算题 · 4 marks4 分
A4.A one-dimensional VAE has μ=2, log σ²=0, ε=−0.5. Compute sampled z, KL(q‖N(0,1)), and the negative ELBO when reconstruction negative log-likelihood is 1.2. Would doubling KL weight change the training objective?一维 VAE 的 μ=2、log σ²=0、ε=−0.5。计算 z、KL(q‖N(0,1))，以及重建负对数似然为 1.2 时的负 ELBO。KL 权重加倍是否改变训练目标？
[4 marks] σ=exp(0/2)=1; z=2−0.5=1.5. KL=½(4+1−0−1)=2. Negative ELBO=1.2+2=3.2 for this reconstruction estimate. Weighting KL by 2 gives 5.2 and is a modified objective rather than the standard ELBO.[4 分] σ=1，z=1.5；KL=2；该重建估计的负 ELBO=1.2+2=3.2。KL 权重设 2 得 5.2，是修改后的目标而非标准 ELBO。
Foundation practice基础练习
1.What prevents an ordinary autoencoder from simply learning the identity?什么防止普通 AE 只学习恒等映射？
Compression or constraints force useful representation; labels and test leakage do not solve it, and no reconstruction loss removes the learning signal.压缩或约束迫使网络学习表示；标签和测试泄漏无助，去掉重构损失则失去学习信号。
2.What does the VAE encoder usually output?VAE 编码器通常输出什么？
The encoder specifies μ and variance; the decoder produces images and a GAN discriminator scores real/fake.编码器指定 μ 与方差；解码器产生图像，GAN 判别器打真伪分数。
3.What is the purpose of reparameterization?重参数化的目的是什么？
Sampling ε separately gives a differentiable function of μ and σ; it preserves randomness and the decoder.独立采样 ε 后可将 z 写为 μ、σ 的可导函数，仍保留随机性与解码器。
4.If a VAE's KL term is weighted excessively, what may happen?VAE 的 KL 项权重过大可能怎样？
Strong prior pressure can make q close to prior at the cost of information; there is no discriminator in the VAE.过强先验压力使 q 接近先验，可能丢失信息；VAE 没有判别器。
5.A denoising autoencoder is trained with which target?去噪自编码器用什么作训练目标？
Corrupted data are the input; clean originals are the reconstruction target, discouraging simple copying.受损数据作输入，干净原图作重构目标，避免简单复制。
6.A generative Gaussian has μ=3 and σ=2. If ε=−1, sample x?生成高斯 μ=3、σ=2、ε=−1，样本 x？
x=μ+σε=3−2=1; ε is standardized noise, not the sample itself.x=μ+σε=3−2=1；ε 是标准噪声而非样本。
7.A contractive autoencoder penalizes what?收缩自编码器惩罚什么？
A Jacobian penalty discourages large changes in hidden representation for small input changes.Jacobian 惩罚限制小输入变化导致大隐表示变化。
8.A diagonal VAE posterior N(0,1) equals its unit-normal prior. KL?VAE 后验 N(0,1) 等于标准正态先验，KL？
Identical distributions have zero KL; it is nonnegative.相同分布 KL=0，KL 非负。

Chapter 13 / 17 · Week 5第 13 / 17 章 · 第 5 周

Adversarial training and GANs对抗训练与 GAN

Lecture deck: 对应课件：5b_Adversarial.pdf · 33 slides33 页
Jump to chapter practice ↓跳到本章练习 ↓

GAN, co-evolution & mode collapseGAN、协同进化与模式崩溃

Artist–critic co-evolution (Blind Watchmaker biomorphs, Sims interactive evolution, PicBreeder) motivates adversarial feedback. GAN generator G maps noise to samples; discriminator D predicts real vs fake. Train alternating adversaries; generator seeks convincing samples. DCGAN uses convolutional discriminator and upsampling generator.

Saturating gradients, oscillation/nonconvergence and mode collapse (many latent inputs map to similar output) are failure modes. Improved objectives/architectures, e.g. Wasserstein-inspired methods, address stability/diversity; latent vector arithmetic may manipulate attributes. GAN has no explicit encoder in basic form, unlike VAE.

艺术家-评论者协同进化（Blind Watchmaker biomorphs、Sims 交互进化、PicBreeder）启发对抗反馈。GAN 生成器 G 将噪声映射到样本，判别器 D 区分真/假。交替训练对抗双方，G 试图以假乱真。DCGAN 使用卷积判别器与上采样生成器。

饱和梯度、振荡/不收敛、模式崩溃（不同隐变量生成相似样本）是失败模式。改进目标/架构如 Wasserstein 方法改善稳定性与多样性；隐向量运算可操作属性。基本 GAN 无显式编码器，不同于 VAE。

Key equation核心公式
The minimax objective is the original GAN formulation; the second line is the commonly used non-saturating generator loss.第一式为原始 GAN 极小极大目标，第二式为常用非饱和生成器损失。

The artist–critic analogy starts with human selection of biomorphs (Blind Watchmaker), genetic programs generating RGB values (Sims), and CPPNs in PicBreeder. Replacing the human critic with a learned network makes both sides adapt. In GAN training, update D on real images and generated samples, then freeze D's weights while backpropagating through it to G.

The original minimax generator loss can saturate when D confidently rejects fake images; the non-saturating loss −ln D(G(z)) gives a stronger signal. If D(fake)=0.01, the latter is 4.605; if 0.8, it is 0.223.

At an ideal equilibrium p_g=p_data, D outputs 1/2. DCGAN uses strided convolution in D, fractional-strided convolution in G, BN, ReLU and final tanh for G, leaky ReLU for D, with images scaled to [−1,1]. Oscillation occurs when one player chases the other; mode collapse maps diverse z to similar images.

The slides discuss improvements including Wasserstein objectives, Lipschitz constraints, progressive growing and GAN variants. Image-vector arithmetic combines latent representations to illustrate learned semantic structure, but not all latent directions are independent.

GANs can yield sharp samples without explicit likelihood; VAEs have a probabilistic encoder/decoder and reconstruction objective.

艺术家–评论家类比源自人类选择 biomorph 的 Blind Watchmaker、遗传程序生成 RGB 的 Sims，以及 PicBreeder 的 CPPN。用学习网络替代人工评论家，使双方共同适应。GAN 训练先用真实/生成样本更新 D，再固定 D 权重并穿过它反传给 G。原 minimax 生成器损失在 D 自信拒绝假图时可能饱和；非饱和 −ln D(G(z)) 提供更强信号。

D(fake)=0.01 时后者为 4.605，0.8 时为 0.223。理想均衡 p_g=p_data 时 D 输出 1/2。DCGAN 在 D 用步幅卷积、G 用分数步幅卷积，使用 BN，G 用 ReLU 和最终 tanh，D 用 leaky ReLU；图像缩放到 [−1,1]。

双方互相追赶会振荡；mode collapse 将不同 z 映射为相似图像。课件讨论 Wasserstein 目标、Lipschitz 约束、渐进式生长及 GAN 变体。

图像向量运算演示隐表示的语义结构，却不保证每个方向独立。GAN 不显式计算似然也可生成锐利图像；VAE 有概率编码器/解码器及重构目标。

The adversarial-training slides also discuss adversarial examples: small, deliberately chosen perturbations that make a classifier mispredict. Gradient ascent on the input increases its classification loss (with model weights fixed), while training on perturbed inputs can improve robustness.

This differs from a GAN, where the generator learns a distribution. The named remedies for mode collapse include conditioning augmentation (vary conditions smoothly), minibatch features/fitness sharing (let D notice lack of diversity across samples), and unrolled GANs (anticipate future discriminator updates).

Wasserstein GAN changes the objective to a critic score approximating transport distance under a Lipschitz constraint; its critic is not a sigmoid real/fake probability.

对抗训练课件还讨论 adversarial examples：刻意选取的小扰动使分类器误判。在固定模型权重时对输入做梯度上升可增大分类损失，用扰动样本训练可提升稳健性。这不同于学习生成分布的 GAN。课件列出的模式坍塌缓解方法有 conditioning augmentation（平滑改变条件）、minibatch features/fitness sharing（让 D 察觉样本之间缺乏多样性）、unrolled GAN（考虑未来判别器更新）。

Wasserstein GAN 将目标改为受 Lipschitz 约束、近似运输距离的 critic 分数；critic 不是 sigmoid 真假概率。

GAN training alternates between two tasks. The discriminator receives real and generated samples and learns to distinguish them. The generator receives latent noise and tries to produce samples that the discriminator rates as real; gradients pass through the discriminator to the generator, but the discriminator's weights are held fixed during the generator step.

If the generator maps many noise inputs to one plausible image, that is mode collapse: individual quality may be high while diversity is poor. WGAN changes the training signal to a critic with a Lipschitz constraint rather than a sigmoid real/fake probability.

GAN 训练交替进行两个任务。判别器接收真实与生成样本，学习区分。生成器接收潜噪声，使输出获得判别器的真实评价；梯度穿过判别器到生成器，但生成器更新阶段固定判别器权重。若大量噪声映射为同一逼真图像，就是模式崩塌：单图质量可能高但多样性差。WGAN 改为有 Lipschitz 约束的 critic 信号，而非 sigmoid 真假概率。

Chapter 14 / 17 · Week 5第 14 / 17 章 · 第 5 周

Word vectors and statistical language models词向量与统计语言模型

Lecture deck: 对应课件：5c_WordVectors.pdf · 49 slides49 页
Jump to chapter practice ↓跳到本章练习 ↓

Statistical language models & distributional semantics统计语言模型与分布语义

Word meaning can be inferred from context (distributional hypothesis). Bag-of-words/frequency features discard ordering; unigram predicts words independently; bigram and n-gram condition on a fixed preceding context. Co-occurrence matrices count neighbours in a window; large windows capture topical similarity, smaller windows often syntactic relations.

SVD gives a low-rank approximation of word-context matrices; eigenvalue decomposition requires a square matrix while SVD handles rectangular matrices. GloVe uses global co-occurrence statistics.

词义可从上下文推断（分布假说）。词袋/频数特征丢失顺序；unigram 独立预测词；bigram 与 n-gram 基于固定长度前文。共现矩阵统计窗口内邻词；大窗口偏主题，小窗口常偏句法。SVD 对词-上下文矩阵作低秩近似；特征值分解要求方阵，SVD 可处理矩形矩阵。GloVe 利用全局共现统计。

Key equation核心公式

A word's meaning can be approximated by the contexts in which it appears, unlike a handcrafted synonym hierarchy. For document classification a bag of words counts vocabulary items, optionally normalized or weighted; it loses order. A bigram model estimates P(wₜ|wₜ₋₁)=count(wₜ₋₁,wₜ)/count(wₜ₋₁).

If after 'deep' we see 'learning' 8 times and 'water' twice, the conditional probabilities are 0.8 and 0.2. A unigram model ignores history, higher-order n-grams improve local context but sparse counts explode. A co-occurrence matrix counts context words in a window; changing window size changes the relationships captured.

SVD factorizes M=UΣVᵀ; truncating to k largest singular values gives a compact low-rank approximation. Unlike eigendecomposition of a square matrix, SVD applies to rectangular matrices and singular values are nonnegative. GloVe uses global co-occurrence statistics; word2vec learns through prediction. A dense vector captures relationships inaccessible to raw one-hot representations.

词的含义可由出现上下文近似，而非依赖人工同义词层级。文档分类中的词袋统计词频，可归一化或加权，但丢失顺序。二元模型估计 P(wₜ|wₜ₋₁)=count(wₜ₋₁,wₜ)/count(wₜ₋₁)。若 deep 后出现 learning 8 次、water 2 次，条件概率为 0.8 和 0.2。一元模型忽略历史，更高阶 n-gram 改善局部上下文，但稀疏计数急剧增加。

共现矩阵统计窗口中的上下文词，窗口大小影响捕获的关系。SVD 分解 M=UΣVᵀ；保留 k 个最大奇异值得到低秩近似。与方阵特征分解不同，SVD 可处理矩形矩阵，奇异值非负。GloVe 使用全局共现统计，word2vec 通过预测学习。稠密向量可表达原始 one-hot 无法表达的关系。

A co-occurrence matrix makes the distributional hypothesis concrete: a row describes the contexts of a word, a column describes a context word. The window size changes what the counts capture; narrow windows emphasize local syntax, wider windows broader topics.

SVD compresses a sparse matrix into dense lower-dimensional representations. An n-gram language model instead estimates the next-word probability from a bounded history; it cannot directly exploit arbitrarily distant context and needs smoothing for unseen sequences.

共现矩阵具体体现分布假设：一行描述某词的上下文，一列代表上下文词。窗口大小改变统计含义，窄窗口偏局部句法，宽窗口偏主题。SVD 将稀疏矩阵压缩为低维稠密表示。n-gram 语言模型估计有限历史下的下一个词概率，无法直接利用任意远的上下文，未见序列还需平滑。

Word2vec: CBOW, skip-gram & trainingWord2vec：CBOW、Skip-gram 与训练

CBOW predicts centre word from neighbouring context; skip-gram predicts context words from centre. One-hot input selects an embedding row; input/output matrices learn dense representations. Full softmax over vocabulary is expensive; hierarchical softmax predicts a tree path, negative sampling distinguishes observed pairs from sampled noise, frequent-word subsampling reduces dominance of common words.

Cosine similarity and vector arithmetic reveal semantic/syntactic analogies (e.g. capitals), not guaranteed logical facts. Multimodal skip-gram links language and visual features; recurrent encoder/attention support translation and captioning.

CBOW 由邻近词预测中心词；skip-gram 由中心词预测上下文。One-hot 选择嵌入矩阵一行；输入/输出矩阵学习稠密表示。完整词表 softmax 昂贵；层次 softmax 预测树路径，负采样区分真实词对与噪声，高频词下采样降低常用词主导。

余弦相似度与向量运算揭示语义/句法类比（如首都），并非逻辑保证。多模态 skip-gram 连接语言和视觉特征；循环编码器与注意力支持翻译和图像描述。

Key equation核心公式

In a one-word context word2vec model the input is one-hot, hidden layer selects a row of the input embedding matrix, and output predicts a vocabulary distribution. With embedding dimension d and vocabulary V, two V×d matrices are learned. The cost is −ln P(context|centre); full softmax updates scores for every word.

CBOW averages or sums context vectors and predicts the centre; skip-gram predicts each neighbouring word from the centre. Hierarchical softmax replaces a vocabulary-wide normalizer with decisions down a tree; negative sampling instead trains logistic discrimination between observed pairs and sampled noise pairs, e.g. −ln σ(v_c·u_w)−Σ ln σ(−v_n·u_w).

Frequent-word subsampling reduces the domination of common words. Cosine similarity compares direction rather than magnitude. Analogies use differences such as king−man+woman≈queen or capital–country relations; they are empirical patterns, not guaranteed algebraic laws. Multimodal skip-gram adds visual contexts; neural translation and image captioning move from fixed vectors to sequence encoders and attention over source positions or image regions.

单词上下文 word2vec 中，one-hot 输入选择输入嵌入矩阵的一行，输出预测词表分布。嵌入维度 d、词表 V 时，学习两个 V×d 矩阵。损失 −ln P(context|centre)，完整 softmax 更新所有词的分数。CBOW 平均或求和上下文向量预测中心词；skip-gram 用中心词预测各邻词。

层次 softmax 将全词表归一化替换为沿树的决策；负采样训练区分观察到的词对与采样的噪声词对，例如 −ln σ(v_c·u_w)−Σ ln σ(−v_n·u_w)。

高频词下采样减少常见词支配。余弦相似度比较方向而非长度。词类比利用 king−man+woman≈queen 或首都–国家等差向量，这些是经验规律，不保证严格代数性质。多模态 skip-gram 加入视觉上下文；神经翻译与图像描述从固定向量发展到序列编码器和源位置/图像区域注意力。

In skip-gram, choose one center word and predict context words; in CBOW, aggregate context vectors and predict the center word. Negative sampling turns one observed word-context pair and several sampled noise pairs into logistic classification problems, avoiding the full vocabulary normalization for every pair.

A dot product controls that binary training score, whereas cosine similarity at evaluation removes vector-length effects. Word analogies arise from geometry learned from corpus statistics; they are not guaranteed facts or perfect logical rules.

Skip-gram 从中心词预测上下文，CBOW 汇总上下文向量预测中心词。负采样把一个观察到的词-上下文对和若干噪声对转成 logistic 分类，避免每对计算全词表归一化。点积决定二元训练分数，评估时余弦相似度去除向量长度影响。词类比来自语料统计学习的几何结构，不是保证正确的事实或逻辑规则。

A3.For vectors a=(2,0), b=(3,4), c=(−1,0), compute cosine similarities cos(a,b), cos(a,c). Which is closer by cosine? Explain why raw dot product can prefer high-norm vectors.a=(2,0), b=(3,4), c=(−1,0)，求 cos(a,b)、cos(a,c)，哪个更近？解释点积为何可能偏好高范数向量。
[3 marks] cos(a,b)=6/(2×5)=0.6; cos(a,c)=−2/(2×1)=−1. b is closer. Dot product multiplies cosine by both norms; cosine normalizes magnitude.[3 分] cos(a,b)=6/10=0.6；cos(a,c)=−2/2=−1，b 更近。点积为余弦乘两范数；余弦消除模长影响。

1.Which model predicts neighbouring words from the centre word?哪个模型从中心词预测邻近词？
Skip-gram reverses CBOW's prediction direction; unigram lacks context, PCA is dimension reduction.Skip-gram 与 CBOW 方向相反；unigram 没有上下文，PCA 用于降维。
2.Why use negative sampling?为什么使用负采样？
It learns observed-versus-noise discrimination with a small set of negatives, rather than exact full softmax.用少量负样本学习真实与噪声的区分，而非完整精确 softmax。
3.If count('deep learning')=6 and count('deep')=10 in the context counts, bigram probability?上下文计数中 deep learning=6、deep=10，二元概率？

4.What does truncated SVD of a co-occurrence matrix retain?共现矩阵截断 SVD 保留什么？
Retain largest singular values and vectors to approximate the matrix; word order is not recovered automatically.保留最大奇异值及向量近似矩阵，不自动恢复词序。
5.What is the CBOW prediction target?CBOW 预测目标是什么？

6.Why use cosine rather than raw dot product for comparing embeddings?为何比较嵌入使用余弦而非直接点积？

Chapter 15 / 17 · Week 7第 15 / 17 章 · 第 7 周

Reinforcement learning强化学习

Lecture deck: 对应课件：COMP9444_Week7_Reinforcement_Learning_2026_final.pdf · 204 slides204 页
Jump to chapter practice ↓跳到本章练习 ↓

Agent, environment, policy & return智能体、环境、策略与回报

Agent observes state s, chooses action a, receives reward r and next state. Transition T and reward R can be deterministic or stochastic; policy π(a|s) may be stochastic (e.g. rock-paper-scissors or aliased observations). RL optimizes delayed return, unlike behavioural cloning (supervised imitation of expert actions).

Model-based RL uses known/learned dynamics to plan; model-free learns from sampled experience. Historical examples: Samuel checkers, MENACE matchboxes. The Markov assumption says current state suffices for predicting next state/reward. Finite horizon, discounted return and average reward are different objectives and can select different optimal actions (café example).

智能体观察状态 s、选择动作 a、获得奖励 r 和下一状态。转移 T 与奖励 R 可确定或随机；策略 π(a|s) 也可随机（如石头剪刀布、观测混淆）。RL 优化延迟回报，不同于行为克隆（监督模仿专家动作）。基于模型 RL 用已知/学习的动态规划；无模型 RL 从采样经验学习。

历史例子：Samuel 跳棋、MENACE 火柴盒。马尔可夫假设指当前状态足以预测下一状态/奖励。有限时域、折扣回报及平均奖励是不同目标（咖啡店例子），可能产生不同最优动作。

Key equation核心公式
Reward indexing follows the lecture convention of immediate reward rₜ. In other notation it is rₜ₊₁. The finite and average expressions shown are undiscounted.奖励索引沿用课件即时奖励 rₜ；其他记法可用 rₜ₊₁。有限时域与平均表达式此处未折扣。

In supervised learning, a correct target is supplied; in RL, the agent acts and its actions affect the future observations and rewards. The Markov decision process comprises states S, actions A, transition distribution P(s′|s,a), reward function, and discount γ. A policy π(a|s) may be deterministic or stochastic; randomization can aid exploration or be useful in competitive environments.

An episode ends at terminal states; continuing tasks may have no terminal. The three objectives in the café exercise are finite-horizon sum, discounted infinite-horizon return, and long-run average reward.

An action with immediate reward may win at a short horizon while an investment yielding later benefits wins for a long horizon; discounting changes their relative value. For rewards 2,5,1 and γ=0.5, the return is 2+2.5+0.25=4.75. Model-based methods use/learn transition and reward rules; model-free methods estimate values or policies from sampled experience.

监督学习给出正确目标；RL 中智能体行动，行动会改变后续观察与奖励。MDP 包含状态 S、动作 A、转移分布 P(s′|s,a)、奖励函数和折扣 γ。策略 π(a|s) 可确定或随机；随机化帮助探索，也可能适合竞争环境。Episode 在终止状态结束，持续任务可无终止。

咖啡馆练习比较有限视野奖励和、折扣无限视野回报、长期平均奖励三种目标。即时收益可能短期更优，投资带来后期收益则长期更优；折扣改变相对价值。

奖励 2、5、1，γ=0.5，回报=2+2.5+0.25=4.75。基于模型方法使用/学习转移和奖励规则，无模型方法从采样经验估计价值或策略。

Read each interaction as a state, an action, a reward and a next state. A policy specifies action probabilities, while the environment specifies what follows an action. An immediate reward is not the same as long-run value: taking an action costing 1 now but yielding 5 next step gives discounted return −1+0.9×5=3.5.

A loop with constant reward 2 and discount 0.8 has value 10, not 2. Finite, discounted and average-reward objectives can select different policies; choose the one actually specified by the question.

每次交互由状态、动作、奖励与下一状态组成。策略指定动作概率，环境指定动作后的结果。即时奖励并非长期价值：现在花费 1、下一步得 5，折扣 0.9 时回报 −1+0.9×5=3.5。每步恒得 2、折扣 0.8 的循环价值为 10，不是 2。有限时域、折扣与平均奖励目标可产生不同策略，按题设选择。

Value functions & Bellman equations价值函数与 Bellman 方程

Vπ(s) is expected return following π from s; Qπ(s,a) conditions on first action. Bellman expectation relates V to immediate reward plus discounted next-state value averaged under policy and dynamics. V* and Q* maximize return, not immediate reward; terminal state's future value is zero. With known model, work backwards or solve recursive equations; in model-free learning, sample transitions.

Greedy with respect to Q* yields optimal policy. Delayed-reward loops show why immediate-reward greedy fails.

Vπ(s) 是从 s 按 π 行动的期望回报；Qπ(s,a) 还限定第一动作。Bellman 期望方程将 V 写为即时奖励加折扣后下一状态价值的期望。V*、Q* 最大化回报而非即时奖励；终止状态未来价值为零。已知模型可逆推或解递归方程；无模型学习使用采样转移。对 Q* 贪心可得到最优策略。延迟奖励循环说明只看即时奖励的贪心为何失败。

Key equation核心公式

Vπ(s)=Eπ[Gₜ|Sₜ=s] evaluates states under the policy; Qπ(s,a) evaluates taking a specific action before following π. The Bellman expectation equation averages over action and transition probabilities. The optimality equation replaces the policy average with max over actions. For a state that loops forever with reward 2 and γ=0.9, V=2+0.9V=20.

If an alternative exits for reward 12, the loop is preferable in discounted continuing evaluation; at finite horizon three steps it gives only 6. With a known model, solve simultaneous equations for fixed π, or iterate Bellman backups; policy improvement greedily chooses actions with greatest Q.

Distinguish the value of a policy from an immediate reward and distinguish V from Q. At terminal states the future value is zero.

Vπ(s)=Eπ[Gₜ|Sₜ=s] 评价策略下的状态；Qπ(s,a) 评价先执行指定动作再遵循 π。Bellman 期望方程对动作和转移概率求期望，最优方程把策略平均替换为动作 max。若状态以奖励 2 无限循环，γ=0.9，则 V=2+0.9V=20。

另一动作以奖励 12 退出，折扣持续目标偏好循环；但有限三步时循环只得 6。已知模型时，可解固定 π 的联立方程，或迭代 Bellman backup；策略改进贪心选择最大 Q 的动作。

区分策略价值、即时奖励以及 V 与 Q。终止状态未来价值为零。

A Bellman equation connects current value to successor value. For deterministic actions under a fixed policy, first write one equation per state. A self-loop with reward 4 and γ=0.5 gives V=4+0.5V, hence V=8. An alternative action yielding 1 and leading to this loop has Q=1+0.5×8=5.

Only when optimizing use the maximum over actions; policy evaluation uses the policy's actual action distribution. Check the claimed optimal policy by verifying its chosen Q is maximal in each state.

Bellman 方程连接当前价值和后继价值。确定动作、固定策略时先为每个状态写一条方程。奖励 4、γ=0.5 的自循环有 V=4+0.5V，故 V=8。另一动作奖励 1 并进入该循环，其 Q=1+0.5×8=5。优化时才对动作取最大，策略评估使用策略自身的动作分布。

可检验每个状态选中动作的 Q 是否最大，从而验证最优策略。

Bellman fixed pointBellman 不动点

1

Under a fixed policy, the loop repeats.固定策略下循环重复。

2

Rearrange rather than truncate the infinite series.移项求解，不截断无穷回报。

3

One action then follow the policy from s.先执行一次动作，随后从 s 依策略行动。

TD(0), TD(λ) & bootstrappingTD(0)、TD(λ) 与自举

Temporal difference uses one sampled transition and a current estimate of next state, so learns without a complete episode/model. TD error δ is target minus old value; η controls update. In deterministic chains η=1 overwrites and can propagate exact values after repetitions; in stochastic settings constant η fluctuates, decaying steps such as 1/n stabilize estimates under suitable conditions.

Bootstrapping means learning estimates using estimates. TD(λ) mixes n-step returns: λ=0 one-step TD, λ=1 Monte Carlo return in episodic settings; bias/variance and credit-assignment trade-offs.

时序差分使用一个采样转移及下一状态的当前估计，无须完整回合或模型。TD 误差 δ 为目标减旧价值，η 控制更新。确定性链中 η=1 覆盖，反复可传播精确值；随机环境固定 η 会波动，适当条件下衰减步长如 1/n 可稳定估计。自举指用估计学习估计。TD(λ) 混合多步回报：λ=0 单步 TD，回合任务中 λ=1 为 Monte Carlo 回报；涉及偏差/方差及信用分配权衡。

Key equation核心公式

A sampled transition (s,r,s′) yields a one-step target r+γV(s′); subtract the current V(s) to obtain TD error δ. Update toward that target with η. For V(s)=3, r=1, γ=0.9, V(s′)=6 and η=0.25, δ=3.4 and V_new=3.85. This bootstraps: the target contains another estimate rather than waiting for a complete return.

In a deterministic environment η=1 may propagate exact values after sufficient visits; in stochastic rewards it may oscillate indefinitely. A diminishing rate such as 1/n for repeated observations can average random targets under suitable conditions.

TD(λ) combines n-step returns with weights (1−λ)λⁿ⁻¹ (with terminal handling); λ=0 uses one-step TD, λ=1 the full episodic return. Eligibility traces implement the backward-view idea by assigning credit to recently visited states. Larger λ reduces reliance on bootstrapping but can increase sampling variance.

采样转移 (s,r,s′) 得一步目标 r+γV(s′)，减去当前 V(s) 即 TD 误差 δ，以 η 向目标更新。V(s)=3、r=1、γ=0.9、V(s′)=6、η=0.25，则 δ=3.4、V_new=3.85。这是自举：目标包含另一个估计，而非等待完整回报。

确定环境下 η=1 在足够访问后可传播准确价值；随机奖励下可能持续波动。对重复观测使用 1/n 等递减步长，在适当条件下可平均随机目标。

TD(λ) 按 (1−λ)λⁿ⁻¹ 加权 n 步回报（另处理终止）；λ=0 为一步 TD，λ=1 为完整 episodic 回报。资格迹实现反向视角，将信用分给最近访问状态。增大 λ 减少自举但可能增加采样方差。

TD(0) uses the reward plus an estimated next value as the target, so learning can start before the end of an episode. If V(s)=2, reward=1, V(s′)=4, γ=0.5 and η=0.2, the target is 3, error is 1, and the new estimate is 2.2. Monte Carlo waits for the realized return.

TD(λ) mixes different n-step returns (or uses eligibility traces) to distribute credit backward; λ controls how much later information affects earlier states, not the discount factor itself.

TD(0) 以奖励加下一状态估计价值为目标，因此不必等回合结束。若 V(s)=2、奖励=1、V(s′)=4、γ=0.5、η=0.2，则目标为 3、误差为 1、更新值为 2.2。Monte Carlo 等实际回报。TD(λ) 混合不同 n 步回报（或用资格迹）向前分配信用；λ 控制更远信息对早期状态的影响，不是折扣因子本身。

Q-learning, exploration & banditsQ-learning、探索与多臂老虎机

Q-learning learns optimal action values off-policy using max next Q even if behaviour explores. ε-greedy chooses greedy action most of the time, otherwise random; softmax/Boltzmann exploration samples by relative estimated value. Multi-armed bandit has immediate action rewards with no state transition dependence; greedy can miss better arms.

Q-learning convergence in tabular setting requires sufficient visits, appropriate decaying learning rates and suitable stationary finite MDP conditions. Example: update one visited state-action pair; terminal target equals reward.

Q-learning 是离策略学习，用下一状态最大 Q 更新最优动作价值，即使行为策略在探索。ε-greedy 多数时间选贪心动作，其余随机；softmax/Boltzmann 探索按相对价值采样。多臂老虎机只有动作即时奖励，不依赖状态转移；纯贪心可能错过优质臂。表格 Q-learning 收敛需要充分访问、适当衰减学习率及平稳有限 MDP 等条件。每次只更新访问的状态动作对；终止目标等于奖励。

Key equation核心公式

Q-learning uses r+γ maxₐ′Q(s′,a′) as target even when the action actually chosen next is exploratory; SARSA would use the sampled next action. Example Q(s,a)=1, r=0, best next Q=5, γ=0.8, η=0.5 gives Q_new=2.5. ε-greedy selects a random action with probability ε and otherwise a greedy one; softmax exploration samples with probability proportional to exp(Q/T), with larger temperature approaching uniform choice.

Exploration is necessary because a high current estimate may be wrong. A multi-armed bandit is the no-state-transition special case of choosing among uncertain reward sources.

Tabular Q-learning converges under standard finite stationary MDP conditions, sufficient exploration and appropriate diminishing learning rates; arbitrary neural approximators do not inherit that guarantee.

Q-learning 的目标是 r+γ maxₐ′Q(s′,a′)，即使下一实际动作是探索动作；SARSA 则使用实际采样动作。例 Q(s,a)=1、r=0、下一最大 Q=5、γ=0.8、η=0.5，Q_new=2.5。ε-greedy 以 ε 概率随机选动作，否则选贪心动作；softmax 探索按 exp(Q/T) 比例采样，温度越高越接近均匀。探索很重要，因为当前高估计可能错误。

多臂老虎机是无状态转移、在不确定奖励源中选择的特例。表格 Q-learning 在有限平稳 MDP、充分探索和适当递减学习率等条件下收敛；任意神经网络近似并不继承该保证。

Q-learning updates the entry corresponding to the action actually taken but bootstraps using the largest next-state Q. Suppose Q(s,a)=2, reward=0, γ=0.9, next-state Q values are 1 and 5, η=0.5. The target is 4.5 and the new entry is 3.25 even if exploration will take the other action next.

That is why Q-learning is off-policy. Exploration must still visit useful alternatives; always taking the currently largest estimate can lock the agent into an inferior action.

Q-learning 更新实际执行动作对应的表项，却使用下一状态最大 Q 自举。设 Q(s,a)=2、奖励=0、γ=0.9、后继 Q 为 1 和 5、η=0.5，目标为 4.5，更新为 3.25，即使探索下一步选另一个动作。这是 off-policy 的原因。

探索仍需访问有用备选动作；始终选当前最大估计可能锁死在次优动作。

Deep Q-networks (DQN)深度 Q 网络（DQN）

Approximate Q with neural network mapping state to action scores; train on squared TD error. Naive deep Q-learning is unstable because transitions are correlated and targets move with weights. Experience replay randomly samples stored (s,a,r,s′,done) tuples; prioritized replay samples important/high-error transitions more often.

A frozen target network generates targets and is periodically synchronized. Atari DQN learns from pixels; sparse rewards and long exploration horizons remain hard. TD-Gammon is an earlier neural RL example.

神经网络近似 Q，从状态输出各动作分数，以 TD 误差平方训练。朴素深度 Q-learning 不稳定，因为转移相关且目标随权重变化。经验回放从存储的 (s,a,r,s′,done) 随机采样；优先回放更常采样重要/高误差转移。冻结目标网络产生目标，定期同步。Atari DQN 从像素学习；稀疏奖励及长探索时域仍困难。TD-Gammon 是更早的神经 RL 例子。

Key equation核心公式

DQN approximates Q(s,a;θ) with a neural network, often using pixels or stacked frames as inputs and one value per discrete action as output. Store transitions in a replay buffer; sample mini-batches to reuse experience and break temporal correlations. A target network θ⁻ is copied from the online network periodically (or slowly updated) and defines y=r+γ max Q(s′,a′;θ⁻), except terminal y=r.

Minimize squared/Huber TD error between y and the online prediction for the chosen action. The target is treated as constant in that gradient step.

The slides' game examples show value learning without hand-crafted action rules. Overestimation from max and changing targets can destabilize learning; replay and target networks help, not prove convergence. Continuous action spaces make a brute-force max difficult, motivating direct policy methods.

DQN 用神经网络近似 Q(s,a;θ)，通常输入像素或多帧，输出每个离散动作的价值。将转移存入经验回放池，随机采样 mini-batch 复用经验并降低时间相关性。目标网络 θ⁻ 定期从在线网络复制（或缓慢更新），定义 y=r+γ max Q(s′,a′;θ⁻)，终止时 y=r。最小化 y 与选定动作在线预测的平方/Huber TD 误差；求梯度时目标视为常数。

游戏例子展示不依赖手写动作规则的价值学习。max 的高估及不断变化的目标会造成不稳定，回放和目标网络有帮助，但不能证明收敛。连续动作空间难以穷举 max，引出直接策略方法。

A DQN maps the observation to one Q estimate per discrete action. During training, sample transitions from replay memory to reduce correlations, then use a target network to compute the next-state bootstrap value. For terminal transitions, omit the bootstrap term entirely.

The target network is frozen for a period and copied/updated from the online network; otherwise a changing online estimate would move both the prediction and the target on every update. Prioritized replay samples more informative transitions but may require importance correction.

DQN 将观测映射为每个离散动作的 Q 估计。训练从回放缓存采样转移以减弱相关性，并用目标网络计算后继自举值。终止转移完全省略自举项。目标网络一段时间内固定，再由在线网络复制或更新；否则在线估计每步变化会同时移动预测与目标。优先回放更常抽到有信息的转移，但可能需重要性修正。

Policy search, policy gradient & REINFORCE策略搜索、策略梯度与 REINFORCE

Value-based methods infer policy from values; policy-based directly parameterize πθ and maximize J(θ)=E[G]. Evolution strategies mutate/evaluate policy parameters, not individual action gradients. Policy gradient uses log-derivative trick to reinforce successful sampled actions. REINFORCE weights log-probability gradients by sampled returns; unbiased under usual assumptions but high variance and delayed credit assignment.

Direct policies handle continuous actions and stochastic strategies more naturally than max over a discrete Q table.

基于价值方法从价值推断策略；基于策略方法直接参数化 πθ 并最大化 J(θ)=E[G]。进化策略变异并评估策略参数，而非单个动作梯度。策略梯度用对数导数技巧增强成功的采样动作。REINFORCE 以采样回报加权对数概率梯度；通常条件下无偏但高方差、信用分配延迟。直接策略比离散 Q 表求最大值更自然地处理连续动作及随机策略。

Key equation核心公式
The displayed policy-gradient estimator is schematic; objective and sampling conventions determine whether an additional discount factor weights each time step.此策略梯度估计式为示意；目标与采样约定决定各时刻是否额外加折扣。

Policy search directly parameterizes πθ, allowing stochastic or continuous actions. Evolution strategies perturb a candidate parameter vector, evaluate whole episodes and retain or combine successful perturbations; they need no differentiable environment but can require many trials. The policy-gradient identity weights the gradient of log probability of sampled actions by a return or action value.

REINFORCE generates complete episodes and updates θ in the ascent direction ηGₜ∇θ ln πθ(aₜ|sₜ) (discount conventions vary). If a sampled action had positive advantage, raise its probability; negative advantage lowers it.

For two softmax actions with probability 0.5 each, the derivative of log π(chosen) with respect to its logit is 0.5. A return of 2 and step size 0.1 increases that logit by 0.1. Complete returns are noisy because later actions and randomness also affect them.

策略搜索直接参数化 πθ，允许随机或连续动作。进化策略扰动候选参数，评价完整 episode，保留或组合成功扰动；不需要可微环境，但可能需要大量试验。策略梯度恒等式用回报或动作价值加权采样动作对数概率的梯度。REINFORCE 生成完整 episode，沿 ηGₜ∇θ ln πθ(aₜ|sₜ) 更新（折扣约定可能不同）。

正优势提高该动作概率，负优势降低。两个 softmax 动作各 0.5 时，选中动作的 log 概率对自身 logit 的导数为 0.5；回报 2、步长 0.1 时该 logit 增加 0.1。

完整回报噪声较大，因为后续动作和随机因素也影响它。

A policy-gradient network outputs probabilities directly, so it naturally supports stochastic policies. For a sampled action, increasing its log probability increases the probability of similar decisions; multiplying by a positive return strengthens good trajectories, negative advantages reduce their probability.

REINFORCE uses sampled returns, which are unbiased under suitable sampling but noisy. A state-dependent baseline independent of the sampled action can lower variance without changing the expected policy gradient. Maximizing expected reward uses gradient ascent.

策略梯度网络直接输出概率，自然支持随机策略。对采样动作，提高其对数概率会增强类似决策；乘正回报强化好轨迹，负优势则降低动作概率。REINFORCE 使用采样回报，适当采样下无偏但噪声大。与采样动作无关的状态基线可以降低方差且不改变期望策略梯度。最大化期望奖励使用梯度上升。

Actor–critic, A3C, PPO & GRPOActor–Critic、A3C、PPO 与 GRPO

Actor learns policy, critic estimates value to grade actions; advantage A=Q−V compares action with baseline, often estimated by TD error, reducing variance. Critic learns by TD; actor increases probability for positive advantage. A3C uses asynchronous parallel workers updating shared parameters.

PPO collects fresh on-policy batches and clips policy probability ratios to limit destructive updates. GRPO estimates relative advantage from a group of completions rather than a learned critic; suited to LLM tasks with comparable rewards.

Actor 学策略，Critic 估计价值来评价动作；优势 A=Q−V 比较动作和基线，常用 TD 误差估计以降低方差。Critic 用 TD 学习；Actor 提高正优势动作概率。A3C 使用异步并行 worker 更新共享参数。PPO 收集新鲜同策略批量，对策略概率比裁剪，限制破坏性更新。GRPO 用一组回答的相对奖励估计优势，不需学习 critic，适合奖励可比较的 LLM 任务。

Key equation核心公式

Actor–critic combines a policy (actor) with a learned value estimator (critic). The advantage A(s,a)=Q(s,a)−V(s) compares the action with the state's baseline; the TD error r+γV(s′)−V(s) is a sampled estimate. Update critic to reduce TD prediction error and actor to increase log probability weighted by advantage.

Subtracting a state-dependent baseline reduces variance without changing the expected policy gradient. A3C uses asynchronous workers collecting experiences and updating shared parameters. PPO collects rollouts using the current policy, estimates advantages, then performs several mini-batch passes using rₜ=π_new/π_old and a clipped objective min(rₜAₜ, clip(rₜ,1−ε,1+ε)Aₜ).

For A=2, r=1.5, ε=0.2, the objective contribution is 2.4 not 3; for negative A the minimum behaves differently, so clipping is not a hard bound on every probability. Collect new trajectories for subsequent rounds. GRPO removes the separate value network and estimates relative advantages from a group of sampled outputs, typically by centering/scaling their rewards; useful when a prompt has several generated candidates.

Actor–critic 结合策略 actor 与学习价值的 critic。优势 A(s,a)=Q(s,a)−V(s) 将动作与状态基线比较；TD 误差 r+γV(s′)−V(s) 是采样估计。critic 减少 TD 预测误差，actor 用优势加权提高 log 概率。减去状态相关基线可降低方差而不改变期望策略梯度。A3C 由异步 worker 收集经验并更新共享参数。

PPO 用当前策略收集轨迹、估计优势，再多轮 mini-batch 优化，概率比 rₜ=π_new/π_old，裁剪目标 min(rₜAₜ, clip(rₜ,1−ε,1+ε)Aₜ)。A=2、r=1.5、ε=0.2 时贡献 2.4 而非 3；负优势的 min 行为不同，裁剪并非硬性限制每个概率。

下一轮收集新轨迹。GRPO 去掉独立价值网络，通过同一 prompt 的一组生成结果的相对奖励（通常中心化/缩放）估计优势。

Actor-critic splits the job: the actor proposes actions, while the critic estimates expected value and supplies a TD-error or advantage signal. PPO reuses a batch of experience but limits the incentive for probability ratios to move too far.

For A=2, ρ=1.4 and ε=0.2, the clipped objective takes min(2.8,2.4)=2.4. For negative advantage the minimum behaves differently; do not always replace the ratio with its clipped value. GRPO can estimate relative advantages from groups of sampled outputs without a separate learned critic.

Actor-critic 分工：actor 提议动作，critic 估计价值并提供 TD 误差或优势信号。PPO 重用经验 batch，但限制概率比变化过大的收益。A=2、ρ=1.4、ε=0.2 时，clipped objective 取 min(2.8,2.4)=2.4。

负优势时 min 行为不同，不应总把比值替换为裁剪值。GRPO 可通过一组采样输出的相对表现估计优势，无需独立学习 critic。

RLHF, DPO, RLVR & world modelsRLHF、DPO、RLVR 与世界模型

RLHF: supervised fine-tuning (SFT), preference data/reward model, RL policy optimization (often PPO plus reference KL). DPO directly optimizes preference pairs relative to a reference without a separate RL rollout loop/reward model. RLVR uses verifiable rewards from checking answers/code/tests instead of learned human preferences; GRPO can compare sampled solutions.

Tool-using agents act in environments with outcomes/rewards. World models learn dynamics, imagine rollouts and plan/learn policies; reduce expensive real experience but errors can compound. Slides illustrate Dreamer, robotics, driving, science, proofs and algorithm discovery; these are application examples, not guarantees.

RLHF：监督微调（SFT）、偏好数据/奖励模型、RL 策略优化（常用 PPO 加参考 KL）。DPO 相对参考模型直接优化偏好对，无独立 RL rollout 循环/奖励模型。RLVR 通过答案、代码、测试验证产生奖励，而不是学习人类偏好；GRPO 可比较采样解。

工具智能体在有结果与奖励的环境行动。世界模型学习动态、想象 rollout 并规划/学习策略；减少昂贵真实经验但误差可能累积。课件例子有 Dreamer、机器人、驾驶、科学、证明和算法发现，非效果保证。

The lecture's final section distinguishes reward sources. RLHF first supervised-fine-tunes on good answers, then learns a reward model from preferred/rejected responses, and finally optimizes the language policy with RL (often PPO plus a KL constraint to a reference). DPO uses the preference pairs directly in an optimization objective, without a separate reward model or rollout RL loop.

RLVR instead uses programmatic checking such as exact mathematical answers or code tests: sample reasoning/answer, check, reinforce successful outputs.

This avoids needing a preference model for verifiable tasks, but a checker can be incomplete or exploited. For tool-using agents the state includes prompt and observations, actions include text/tool calls, and a sandbox plus task checker supplies reward. World models learn a transition/reward predictor, imagine rollouts and improve policies before collecting more real experience; Dreamer-style examples and Minecraft demonstrate sparse rewards, while robotics illustrates real-world cost and safety.

These named examples are lecture illustrations, not a claim that a particular model is currently state of the art.

课件最后区分奖励来源。RLHF 先对优质答案监督微调，再由偏好/拒绝回答训练奖励模型，最后用 RL 优化语言策略（常见 PPO 加参考策略 KL 约束）。DPO 直接用偏好对优化，不需要独立奖励模型或 RL rollout 循环。RLVR 用程序检查数学答案或代码测试等：采样推理与答案、检查、强化成功输出。可验证任务无需偏好模型，但 checker 可能不完整或被利用。

工具智能体的状态含 prompt 和观察，动作含文本/工具调用，沙盒及任务 checker 提供奖励。世界模型学习转移/奖励预测、在想象轨迹中改善策略，再收集更多真实经验；Dreamer 和 Minecraft 例子展示稀疏奖励，机器人体现真实试验成本和安全问题。这些模型是课件示例，不代表当前最先进系统的断言。

For a language model, a state is a prompt plus tokens already generated, and an action is another token. RLHF commonly starts with supervised instruction tuning, learns a reward model from human preferences, then optimizes the policy subject to constraints.

DPO optimizes preference pairs directly without the same online RL loop; RLVR instead uses a verifiable outcome such as a correct program test. These methods learn from different supervision signals. A world model predicts possible future transitions to support planning, while a model-free agent may directly learn a policy or value function.

对语言模型，状态是提示与已生成 token，动作是下一 token。RLHF 常先指令微调，再由人类偏好学习奖励模型，最后带约束优化策略。DPO 直接优化偏好对，不走相同在线 RL 循环；RLVR 使用可验证结果，例如程序测试是否通过。这些方法监督信号不同。

世界模型预测未来转移以辅助规划，model-free 则可直接学策略或价值。

Foundation practice基础练习
1.Which is required by the Markov assumption?马尔可夫假设要求什么？
Markov concerns conditional dependence, not reward sign, deterministic policy or termination.Markov 描述条件依赖关系，不限制奖励符号、策略或终止。
2.Rewards 2 then 5, γ=0.6, then terminal. Return?奖励依次为 2、5，γ=0.6，随后终止，回报？
2+0.6×5=5; 7 ignores discount, 3 omits first reward.2+0.6×5=5；7 忽略折扣，3 忽略首个奖励。
3.V(s)=4, r=2, V(s′)=5, γ=0.8, η=0.5. TD(0) new value?V(s)=4，r=2，V(s′)=5，γ=0.8，η=0.5，TD(0) 更新值？
Target=6, error=2, update adds 1. Target is not the updated estimate unless η=1.目标=6，误差=2，更新增加 1；η=1 时目标才等于更新值。
4.Why is Q-learning off-policy?Q-learning 为什么是 off-policy？
The target and behaviour can differ; Q-learning learns from transitions without expert labels or full returns.目标与行为策略可不同；无需专家标签或完整回报。
5.In DQN, what reduces instability from changing TD targets?DQN 中哪个减少 TD 目标不断变化导致的不稳定？
Frozen target parameters stabilize targets; replay addresses correlation and no true Q labels are given.冻结目标参数稳定目标；回放处理相关性，而真实 Q 标签并未提供。
6.What does a critic contribute to actor–critic?Actor–critic 中 critic 提供什么？
The critic provides an estimate to guide policy updates and reduce variance, not exact labels or guarantees.Critic 的估计指导策略更新并降低方差，而不是提供精确标签或保证。
7.PPO with ε=0.2, positive advantage and ratio 1.5: what clipped ratio limits the improvement term?PPO 中 ε=0.2、优势为正、概率比 1.5，裁剪后的有效上限？
For positive A, min picks the capped 1.2A rather than 1.5A; 0.8 is the lower bound.A 为正时 min 选 1.2A 而非 1.5A；0.8 是下限。
8.Which describes DPO versus standard RLHF with PPO?相比标准 PPO RLHF，DPO 的描述是？
DPO uses a direct preference objective; conventional PPO RLHF typically uses reward model and critic.DPO 用直接偏好目标；常规 PPO RLHF 通常使用奖励模型和 critic。
9.GRPO's typical advantage baseline comes from?GRPO 通常的优势基线来自？
Group-relative rewards provide the baseline; this avoids a separate learned critic in the typical formulation.组内相对奖励提供基线，典型形式不需要独立学习 critic。
10.For episodic TD(λ), what do λ=0 and λ=1 correspond to in the usual forward view?在 episodic TD(λ) 常见前向视角中，λ=0 和 λ=1 分别对应？
λ weights multi-step returns; at 0 only one-step matters, at 1 the complete episodic return is used.λ 给多步回报加权，0 仅一步，1 用完整 episode 回报。
11.A state loops with reward 3 forever and γ=0.75. Its value?状态无限循环、奖励3、γ=0.75，价值？
V=3+0.75V, so V=12; discount makes the geometric sum finite.V=3+0.75V，故12；折扣使几何和有限。
12.Q(s,a)=2, reward 1, next max Q=4, γ=0.5, η=0.25. Updated Q?Q=2、奖励1、下一最大Q=4、γ=0.5、η=0.25，更新？
Target=1+0.5×4=3; update a quarter of (3−2).目标3，向目标更新四分之一即2.25。
13.Why use replay in DQN?为何 DQN 使用经验回放？
Random batches improve sample efficiency and decorrelation; they do not prove optimality or replace rewards.随机批提高样本效率并去相关，不证明最优也不替代奖励。
14.What does larger exploration temperature normally do?较大探索温度通常如何？
Dividing Q by larger T reduces score differences; very low T favors high-value actions.较大 T 缩小分数差；很低 T 偏向高价值动作。
15.Which method uses complete sampled returns without a learned critic in its basic form?哪种基础方法用完整采样回报而无学习 critic？
REINFORCE is Monte Carlo policy gradient; actor–critic uses a critic, others are different tasks.REINFORCE 为 Monte Carlo 策略梯度；actor–critic 用 critic，其他任务不同。
16.A(s,a)=−2. What should a policy gradient tend to do to that action's probability?A(s,a)=−2，策略梯度通常如何改变动作概率？
Negative advantage indicates worse-than-baseline action; ascent with negative weight reduces its log probability locally.负优势表示低于基线；负权重梯度上升局部降低 log 概率。
17.Which reward is typical of RLVR?RLVR 的典型奖励？
RLVR uses verifiable outcomes; preference-based reward modeling is typical RLHF.RLVR 用可验证结果；偏好奖励模型属于典型 RLHF。
18.Why learn a world model for RL?为何 RL 学世界模型？
Model-based imagination can reduce real interaction; model errors and exploration still matter.基于模型的想象减少真实交互；模型误差和探索仍重要。

Sequence modeling I: recurrent networks序列建模 I：循环网络

Lecture deck: 对应课件：Sequence_Modeling_1_2026_final.pdf · 119 slides119 页
Jump to chapter practice ↓跳到本章练习 ↓

Sequences, tokenisation & backbones序列、分词与主干模型

Sequence tasks include speech, text, DNA/protein, temporal signals; order matters. Input/output patterns: one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-one, aligned many-to-many and encoder–decoder. Tokenization maps units to IDs; embeddings map IDs to vectors. BPE repeatedly merges common adjacent units, balancing vocabulary size and sequence length; subwords handle rare words.

Self-supervised pretraining creates targets from data; supervised backbone uses labels; a shared backbone plus task head can be fine-tuned for multiple tasks. NETtalk predicts pronunciation from a fixed context window, limited by unseen long-range dependencies.

序列任务包括语音、文本、DNA/蛋白质、时间信号；顺序重要。输入输出模式包括一对一、一对多、多对一、对齐多对多和编码器-解码器。分词将单位映射为 ID，嵌入将 ID 映射为向量。BPE 反复合并常见相邻单位，平衡词表大小与长度；子词处理低频词。自监督预训练从数据构建目标，监督主干用标签；共享主干加任务头可微调到多个任务。NETtalk 用固定上下文窗口预测读音，无法处理窗口外长期依赖。

A sequence differs from an unordered feature vector because permuting its elements changes meaning. The slides cover language, DNA, proteins, speech, time series and other ordered modalities. Map tokens to integer IDs and embeddings: character/byte vocabularies are small but long, whole-word vocabularies shorten sequences but struggle with rare words, and subwords compromise.

BPE repeatedly merges frequent adjacent symbol pairs in training; at inference use the learned merges, not new merges per sentence. Different tokenizers split the same text differently, affecting sequence length and computational cost.

DNA has a small nucleotide alphabet and proteins amino-acid symbols; special tokens or multi-character units are possible. A backbone maps an input sequence into learned representations, with a task-specific head for classification, tagging, regression or generation. Self-supervision obtains targets from data (masked/next token); supervised training uses supplied task labels.

A single pretrained backbone can support many heads; distinguish one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-one, aligned many-to-many and encoder–decoder mappings.

序列不同于无序特征向量，重排列会改变含义。课件包含语言、DNA、蛋白质、语音、时间序列等。将 token 映射到整数 ID 和嵌入：字符/字节词表小但序列长，整词词表缩短序列却难处理罕见词，子词折中。BPE 在训练中反复合并高频相邻符号对，推理时使用已学习的合并规则，而非每句重新学习。

不同 tokenizer 对同一文本切分不同，影响长度和计算成本。DNA 字母表较小，蛋白质使用氨基酸符号，也可采用特殊 token 或多字符单元。

主干模型将序列映射为表示，任务头完成分类、标注、回归或生成。自监督从数据本身获得目标（掩码/下一 token），监督学习用任务标签。一个预训练主干可支持多个任务头；区分一对一、一对多、多对一、对齐多对多以及编码器–解码器映射。

Tokenization turns a sequence of variable-length text into a sequence of vocabulary IDs, not yet meaningful vectors. BPE repeatedly merges frequent adjacent symbols; then an embedding matrix maps IDs to vectors. A fixed sliding window such as NETtalk sees only bounded context, so identical visible windows must produce the same outputs even if an earlier word changes the answer.

Sequence backbones learn context-dependent features; supervised heads then adapt these features to classification, tagging or generation tasks.

分词把变长文本变为词表 ID 序列，此时还不是语义向量。BPE 反复合并高频相邻符号，随后 embedding 矩阵把 ID 映射为向量。NETtalk 等固定滑窗只能看到有限上下文，因此可见窗口相同便输出相同，即便更早词会改变正确答案。序列 backbone 学习上下文相关特征，再由监督任务头适配分类、标注或生成。

Simple RNN & BPTT简单 RNN 与时间反向传播

Elman RNN combines current input and prior hidden state using shared recurrent weights. Unrolling across time forms a deep graph; backpropagation through time (BPTT) sums shared-weight gradients. Memory compresses the past; repeated Jacobian products cause vanishing/exploding gradients, fading early information. Gradient clipping limits explosions but does not restore lost long-distance gradients. RNN is sequential across positions.

Elman RNN 用共享循环权重结合当前输入与上一隐藏状态。沿时间展开形成深层图；BPTT 对共享权重的梯度求和。记忆压缩历史；反复乘 Jacobian 导致梯度消失/爆炸，早期信息衰减。梯度裁剪限制爆炸，但不能恢复丢失的长程梯度。RNN 在位置间顺序计算。

Key equation核心公式

NETtalk predicts pronunciations from a fixed window of characters; neighbouring letters disambiguate sounds, but a fixed window fails when relevant context is farther away. A simple RNN replaces the window with state: hₜ=f(Wₓxₜ+Wₕhₜ₋₁+b), ŷₜ=g(Wᵧhₜ+c). Elman's network feeds hidden activations back as context.

Unrolling exposes a deep computational graph with shared parameters at every time, so BPTT sums parameter gradients from all time steps. For a scalar linear recurrence hₜ=0.5hₜ₋₁+xₜ, an input five steps ago has coefficient 0.5⁵=1/32; if the recurrent factor is 2, it grows to 32.

This illustrates fading information and vanishing/exploding gradients. Gradient clipping bounds large gradients but does not restore lost long-range information. Truncated BPTT limits the number of steps used for credit assignment; recurrent computation also limits training parallelism across positions.

NETtalk 根据固定字符窗口预测发音，邻近字母消除发音歧义，但远处相关信息超出窗口时失败。简单 RNN 用状态替代固定窗口：hₜ=f(Wₓxₜ+Wₕhₜ₋₁+b)，ŷₜ=g(Wᵧhₜ+c)。Elman 网络把隐藏激活反馈作上下文。按时间展开成为共享参数的深计算图，BPTT 汇总各时刻参数梯度。

标量线性递推 hₜ=0.5hₜ₋₁+xₜ 中，五步前输入的系数为 0.5⁵=1/32；若递推因子为 2，则增长至 32。

这说明信息衰减与梯度消失/爆炸。梯度裁剪限制过大梯度，却不能恢复丢失的长程信息。截断 BPTT 限制信用分配的步数；循环计算也限制不同位置间的训练并行性。

Unrolling an RNN exposes one computational copy per time step, but all copies share the same weights. For a scalar linear recurrence h_t=0.5h_{t−1} with no new inputs, an early signal is multiplied by 0.5 each step; after ten steps its magnitude is about 0.00098 of the original.

The gradient has the same repeated-factor problem, explaining vanishing gradients. With a factor larger than 1, it may explode instead. BPTT sums parameter gradient contributions across time because the weights are shared.

展开 RNN 可见每个时刻一个计算副本，但副本共享权重。标量线性递推 h_t=0.5h_{t−1} 且无新输入时，早期信号每步乘 0.5，十步后仅为原来的约 0.00098。梯度也面临重复乘因子，因此消失；因子大于 1 则可能爆炸。BPTT 累加各时刻对共享参数的梯度贡献。

LSTM & GRULSTM 与 GRU

LSTM maintains cell state c and hidden state h; forget gate retains memory, input gate writes candidate information, output gate controls exposure. Additive cell updates support longer gradient paths. GRU uses reset gate to control old state in candidate and update gate to interpolate candidate/old state; no separate cell/output gate, usually fewer parameters. Gate values are learned, not hand-set; both remain sequential and have finite memory capacity.

LSTM 维护细胞状态 c 与隐藏状态 h；遗忘门保留记忆、输入门写入候选信息、输出门控制暴露。加性状态更新帮助长程梯度。GRU 用重置门控制候选中的旧状态，更新门插值候选与旧状态；无独立细胞及输出门，通常参数更少。门值是学习得到的，非手工设定；两者仍顺序计算且记忆容量有限。

Key equation核心公式
LSTM gates f, i, o are sigmoid outputs, candidate g uses tanh. The GRU line uses the convention where z weights the candidate update; some sources reverse z and 1−z.LSTM 的 f、i、o 为 sigmoid，候选 g 用 tanh。GRU 此处 z 为候选更新权重，其他资料可能交换 z 与 1−z。

LSTM has a cell c and exposed hidden state h. The forget gate f retains old cell memory; input gate i controls writing candidate g; output gate o determines the exposed tanh(c). All three gates are sigmoids applied to affine combinations of xₜ and hₜ₋₁, and g is usually tanh. The additive cell update allows a gradient path with repeated f factors; when f≈1 memory can persist.

Example c_old=0.8, f=0.9, i=0.2, g=−0.5 gives c_new=0.62; o=0.5 gives h≈0.276. In the lecture's subject-number example, plural information may be written at 'dogs', retained across intervening words, and exposed near the verb; other cells may track quote boundaries, sentiment or position.

GRU uses an update gate and a reset gate, combines old and candidate hidden states, and has no separate cell/output gate. With one convention hₜ=(1−z)hₜ₋₁+z·h̃ₜ; another names the complement z, so read the equation in the question. Both gated models still compress all history into a finite state and process positions sequentially.

LSTM 有记忆单元 c 和外显隐藏状态 h。遗忘门 f 保留旧记忆，输入门 i 控制写入候选 g，输出门 o 控制暴露的 tanh(c)。三个门是 xₜ 和 hₜ₋₁ 仿射组合的 sigmoid，g 通常为 tanh。加法式 cell 更新提供连续乘 f 的梯度路径；f≈1 时记忆可持久。

例：c_old=0.8、f=0.9、i=0.2、g=−0.5 得 c_new=0.62；o=0.5 得 h≈0.276。

课件主语单复数例子在 dogs 写入复数信息，经过插入词仍保留，接近动词时暴露；其他单元可记录引号、情感或位置。GRU 使用更新门和重置门，组合旧状态与候选状态，无独立 cell/输出门。一种约定 hₜ=(1−z)hₜ₋₁+z·h̃ₜ，另一种将互补门称为 z，计算时以题目公式为准。两类门控网络仍把全部历史压缩为有限状态，并按位置顺序计算。

Read an LSTM as a controlled memory line. The forget gate determines how much old cell state remains, the input gate controls the proposed update, and the output gate controls what becomes visible as hidden state. With c_old=2, f=0.75, i=0.5, g=−0.4, the new cell is 1.3; o=0.8 gives h=0.8 tanh(1.3)≈0.689.

Along the direct cell path, forgetting factors close to one preserve gradients. GRU combines memory and output more compactly through reset and update gates; check its update-gate convention.

把 LSTM 理解成受控记忆线：遗忘门确定旧 cell 保留多少，输入门控制候选更新，输出门控制对外可见的隐藏状态。c_old=2、f=0.75、i=0.5、g=−0.4，新 cell=1.3；o=0.8 得 h≈0.689。直接 cell 路径的遗忘门接近 1 时有利于保留梯度。

GRU 用 reset 和 update 门更紧凑地结合记忆与输出，需核对更新门约定。

Bidirectionality & encoder–decoder attention双向模型、编码器-解码器与注意力

Bidirectional RNN/LSTM/GRU combines forward and backward context, useful for tagging, speech, protein secondary structure and DNA splice sites when whole input is available. It cannot read unseen future tokens in causal generation. Seq2seq encodes source then decodes target, attention computes weighted combinations of encoder states to avoid a single fixed-vector bottleneck.

Translation and captioning benefit from alignment. Teacher forcing supplies true previous tokens during training; generation feeds its own outputs.

双向 RNN/LSTM/GRU 结合正向与反向上下文，适合已知完整输入的词性标注、语音、蛋白质二级结构和 DNA 剪接位点。因果生成不能读取未来未见 token。Seq2seq 先编码源序列再解码目标；注意力加权组合编码器状态，避免单一固定向量瓶颈。翻译和图像描述受益于对齐。Teacher forcing 训练时提供真实前一 token，生成时使用自身输出。

A bidirectional network runs one recurrent layer from left to right and another right to left; concatenate their states at each position. A word tag can depend on later context (e.g. 'bank' followed by 'account'), and protein/DNA annotation can depend on both flanks. Offline speech and whole-sentence encoding also benefit.

It is not suitable for causal next-token prediction if future tokens are unavailable. In an encoder–decoder, the encoder can read the complete source sequence, while the decoder generates the target autoregressively.

Attention lets the decoder use a weighted combination of source states instead of requiring the final encoder state to remember every detail. The next lecture develops this into the Transformer.

双向网络一层从左到右，另一层从右到左，每个位置拼接状态。词性或实体标注可依赖后文（如 bank 后接 account）；蛋白质/DNA 标注可依赖两侧序列。离线语音及整句编码也受益。未来 token 不可用时，双向模型不适合因果下一 token 预测。编码器–解码器中，编码器读完整源序列，解码器自回归生成目标。注意力让解码器使用源状态的加权组合，而非要求最后的编码器状态记住所有细节。

下一讲将其发展为 Transformer。

A bidirectional encoder combines left-to-right and right-to-left states at each position. This helps tagging when both sides of a word are available but cannot be used unmasked for next-token generation. In sequence-to-sequence translation a fixed final encoder state may lose information for long inputs.

Attention instead weights encoder states for each decoder step, giving a changing context vector. Distinguish the encoder representations, attention weights that sum to one, and the weighted value vector; attention weights alone are not the output word probabilities.

双向编码器结合每个位置从左到右与从右到左的状态。两侧词均可见的标注任务因此受益，但下一 token 生成不能无掩码使用未来。seq2seq 翻译中固定最终编码器状态可能丢失长输入信息。Attention 为每个解码步对编码器状态加权，得到变化的上下文。

区分编码器表示、和为 1 的注意力权重以及加权 value 向量；权重本身并非输出词概率。

E1.An LSTM has scalar cell state c₀=1.5. At step 1, (f,i,g,o)=(0.8,0.5,−0.4,0.6); at step 2, (f,i,g,o)=(0.25,0.9,0.8,0.7). Compute the cell and hidden states at both steps.LSTM 标量初始 cell c₀=1.5。第一步 (f,i,g,o)=(0.8,0.5,−0.4,0.6)，第二步 (0.25,0.9,0.8,0.7)。计算两步 cell 和 hidden state。
The recurrence carries the cell state, not the previous hidden state in place of c.
递推旧 c 而非旧 h 替代 c。
Short answer · 3 marks简答题 · 3 分
E2.Why is LSTM generally better than a simple RNN at learning long-range dependencies? Name the three gates and explain their roles.为何 LSTM 通常比简单 RNN 更善于学习长距离依赖？列三个门及其作用。
1 mark: repeated recurrent derivatives in simple RNN may vanish/explode.
1 mark: forget gate preserves/removes old cell state; input gate controls candidate write.
1 mark: output gate exposes cell content; additive cell update with forget near 1 provides a direct gradient path.1 分：简单 RNN 重复乘循环导数可能消失/爆炸。
1 分：遗忘门保留/移除旧 cell，输入门控制候选写入。
1 分：输出门暴露 cell 内容；遗忘接近 1 的加法更新提供直接梯度路径。
Numerical answer数值填空
A1.A scalar linear RNN hₜ=0.5hₜ₋₁+xₜ, h₀=0, receives (1,0,0.75). Find h₃.标量线性 RNN hₜ=0.5hₜ₋₁+xₜ，h₀=0，输入 (1,0,0.75)。求 h₃。
h₁=1, h₂=0.5, h₃=0.25+0.75=1.h₁=1，h₂=0.5，h₃=1。
Numerical answer数值填空
A2.An LSTM scalar cell has c_prev=2, forget gate f=0.6, input gate i=0.5, candidate g=0.4. Compute new cell state c.LSTM 标量单元 c_prev=2，遗忘门 f=0.6，输入门 i=0.5，候选 g=0.4。求新状态 c。
c=f c_prev+i g=0.6×2+0.5×0.4=1.4.c=0.6×2+0.5×0.4=1.4。
Derivation / proof推导 / 证明 · 4 marks4 分
A3.In hₜ=a hₜ₋₁+xₜ, derive ∂h_T/∂h₀. Explain the cases |a|<1 and |a|>1 and why an LSTM can mitigate but not universally eliminate the issue.hₜ=a hₜ₋₁+xₜ，推导 ∂h_T/∂h₀。解释 |a|<1、|a|>1，及 LSTM 为何可缓解但不能普遍消除问题。
[4 marks] Each local derivative is a, so the product is a^T. Magnitude vanishes for |a|<1 and grows for |a|>1. LSTM cell-state additive updates and forget gates near 1 can maintain a direct gradient path, but gates can attenuate and other paths may be unstable.[4 分] 每一步导数为 a，连乘得 a^T。|a|<1 时消失，|a|>1 时爆炸。LSTM 状态加性更新及接近 1 的遗忘门可维持直接梯度路径，但门可能衰减，其他路径也可能不稳定。
Multiple select多选题
A4.Which statements about sequence modelling are valid? Select all.关于序列建模，哪些说法成立？多选。
Select every correct option. More than one is correct.选择所有正确选项，答案不止一个。
A. Incorrect错误 Future tokens are unavailable at generation time.生成时未来 token 不可用。
B. Correct正确 Unrolled copies contribute gradients to the same weights.展开后的各副本向相同权重累积梯度。
C. Incorrect错误 The standard cell has a separate output gate acting on tanh(c).标准 LSTM 有独立输出门作用于 tanh(c)。
D. Correct正确 Attention forms a context-dependent weighted combination.注意力形成依赖上下文的加权组合。
Code analysis代码分析题 · 4 marks4 分
A5.In batch-first recurrent modelling, a one-layer unidirectional RNN with input_size=8 and hidden_size=12 receives x of shape (4,6,8). State the shapes of output and final hidden state in PyTorch. If the task is per-token classification into 5 classes, what shape results from a shared nn.Linear(12,5) on output? Why is using only the final state insufficient for general token labelling?batch_first 循环建模中，一层单向 RNN 的 input_size=8、hidden_size=12，输入 x 形状 (4,6,8)。给出 PyTorch 的 output、最终 hidden state 形状。每 token 做 5 类分类时，共享 nn.Linear(12,5) 作用于 output 得何形状？为何仅最终状态通常不足以做逐 token 标注？
[4 marks] output (4,6,12); hidden (1,4,12), since batch_first does not change hidden-state layout. Applying the linear head yields (4,6,5). Each token needs its corresponding time representation; a single final vector has no separate output for each position without an additional decoder.[4 分] output=(4,6,12)，hidden=(1,4,12)，batch_first 不改变 hidden 布局。线性头输出 (4,6,5)。每个 token 需相应时间表示；单最终向量不经额外解码无法提供各位置独立输出。
Foundation practice基础练习
1.What does BPE do?BPE 做什么？
BPE constructs subword vocabulary; embeddings and recurrent gates are separate.BPE 构造子词词表；嵌入与循环门是另外的运算。
2.What is shared across RNN time steps?RNN 在不同时间步共享什么？
The weights are tied, while states and inputs generally change.权重共享，状态与输入通常改变。
3.Why does an LSTM improve long-term credit assignment?LSTM 为什么有助长程信用分配？
The cell path can retain information/gradients; LSTM remains recurrent, and bidirectionality is optional.细胞路径可保存信息与梯度，LSTM 仍是循环网络，双向是可选的。
4.Old cell 4, forget 0.5, input 0.25, candidate 0.8. New cell?旧 c=4，遗忘门 0.5，输入门 0.25，候选 0.8，新 c？
0.5×4+0.25×0.8=2.2; the output gate is not in the cell update.0.5×4+0.25×0.8=2.2；输出门不参与细胞更新。
5.Which approach is suitable for causal next-token generation?哪个适合因果下一 token 生成？
Causality prohibits future access; teacher forcing is training-only, and bag of words discards order.因果性禁止访问未来；teacher forcing 用于训练，词袋丢失顺序。
6.Which gate controls exposure of LSTM cell memory in hₜ?哪个门控制 LSTM 细胞记忆在 hₜ 中的暴露？
hₜ=oₜ⊙tanh(cₜ); forget and input gates alter memory, and reset is a GRU gate.hₜ=oₜ⊙tanh(cₜ)；遗忘与输入门改变记忆，重置门属于 GRU。
7.What is a limitation of NETtalk-style fixed windows?NETtalk 固定窗口的局限？
Fixed windows use nearby context but not arbitrarily distant information; recurrence is an alternative.固定窗口可用近邻但非任意远信息；循环是替代方法。
8.In hₜ=0.8hₜ₋₁+xₜ, how much of an input three steps ago remains?hₜ=0.8hₜ₋₁+xₜ，三步前输入系数？
Repeated recurrence multiplies by 0.8³=0.512.递推连乘0.8³=0.512。
9.What distinguishes a GRU from an LSTM?GRU 与 LSTM 区别？
GRU combines memory in h using reset/update gates; LSTM has a separate cell and three main gates.GRU 以重置/更新门组合 h；LSTM 有独立 cell 和三个主门。
10.Which task naturally benefits from bidirectional context?哪个任务自然受益双向上下文？
Both left and right context are available in tagging; causal prediction must not use future answers.标注可见左右文；因果预测不可使用未来答案。
