Sequence modeling II: Transformers and beyond序列建模 II：Transformer 与后续架构

Lecture deck: 对应课件：Sequence_Modeling_2_2026_final.pdf · 133 slides133 页
Jump to chapter practice ↓跳到本章练习 ↓

Transformer, embeddings & positionTransformer、嵌入与位置

Transformer uses attention and token-wise feed-forward networks rather than recurrent hidden states. Encoder-only (BERT) reads both directions; decoder-only (GPT) uses causal mask; encoder–decoder uses source encoder plus causal decoder/cross-attention. Input token embeddings need positional information: learned position embeddings (BERT/GPT examples), sinusoidal encoding in original paper, RoPE rotates query/key by position.

BERT also uses segment embeddings and special [CLS], [SEP], [MASK] tokens. Without positional signals, unmasked self-attention is permutation equivariant.

Transformer 使用注意力和逐 token 前馈网络，而非循环隐藏状态。纯编码器（BERT）双向读；纯解码器（GPT）因果掩码；编码器-解码器用源编码器、因果解码器和交叉注意力。Token 嵌入需位置信息：学习式位置嵌入（BERT/GPT 例子）、原论文正弦位置编码、RoPE 按位置旋转 query/key。

BERT 还用句段嵌入及 [CLS]、[SEP]、[MASK] 特殊 token。无位置信号时无掩码自注意力具有置换等变性。

Key equation核心公式

The original Transformer dispenses with recurrence: positions interact via attention, with a positionwise feed-forward network after attention. Encoder-only (BERT) reads the whole input; decoder-only (GPT) predicts future tokens using a causal mask; encoder–decoder (original translation model) reads source bidirectionally and generates target autoregressively.

BERT input sums token, positional and segment embeddings (e.g. [CLS], [SEP]); a classifier can read [CLS], while token tagging uses contextual token states. Original BERT uses masked-language modeling and next-sentence prediction; modern encoders may alter these objectives.

GPT uses shifted next-token targets. Positional information matters because unmasked self-attention alone is permutation-equivariant. The original sinusoidal encoding uses sin(pos/10000²ⁱ/ᵈ) and cos at paired dimensions; learned absolute embeddings are another option.

原 Transformer 不使用循环：位置通过注意力交互，随后是逐位置前馈网络。Encoder-only（BERT）读完整输入；Decoder-only（GPT）用因果掩码预测未来 token；Encoder–decoder（原翻译模型）双向读取源并自回归生成目标。

BERT 输入加和 token、位置和 segment 嵌入（含 [CLS]、[SEP]）；分类可读 [CLS]，序列标注读每个位置。

原始 BERT 使用掩码语言建模与下一句预测，现代 encoder 可能改动目标。GPT 使用移位的下一 token 目标。无掩码自注意力本身排列等变，因此需要位置。原正弦位置编码在成对维度使用 sin(pos/10000²ⁱ/ᵈ) 与 cos；另一选择是学习绝对位置嵌入。

Unlike recurrence, self-attention can access many token positions at once; without positional information it does not know their order. Add a positional signal to token embeddings (or inject relative position in attention) to distinguish sequences with the same words but different arrangements.

An encoder such as BERT can use both left and right context to predict masked tokens; a decoder such as GPT uses a causal mask to predict the next token. The original encoder–decoder architecture uses an encoded source sequence and autoregressive target generation.

不同于循环，self-attention 可同时访问许多 token 位置；若无位置信息，它并不知道顺序。给 token embedding 加位置（或在注意力中注入相对位置），区分词相同而排列不同的序列。BERT 编码器可用左右上下文预测掩码词；GPT 解码器用因果掩码预测下一 token。

原始 encoder-decoder 则编码源序列并自回归生成目标。

Scaled dot-product attention & multi-head缩放点积注意力与多头注意力

Project X to Q (queries), K (keys), V (values). Each query scores keys by dot product divided by √dₖ, row-softmax gives weights, then weighted sums of V. Scaling prevents large logits from saturating softmax. Mask sets disallowed scores to −∞ before softmax; GPT masks future tokens. Multi-head attention computes independent learned projections, concatenates heads and applies output projection Wᴼ.

Cross-attention uses decoder queries and encoder keys/values; self-attention uses same input for all three.

将 X 投影为 Q（查询）、K（键）、V（值）。每个 query 与 key 点积再除 √dₖ，逐行 softmax 得权重，最后对 V 加权求和。缩放防止大 logit 使 softmax 饱和。掩码在 softmax 前把禁止位置设为 −∞；GPT 遮蔽未来 token。多头注意力用独立学习投影，拼接各头后经输出投影 Wᴼ。交叉注意力使用解码器 Q、编码器 K/V；自注意力三者来自同一输入。

Key equation核心公式

For input matrix X (n tokens × d_model), form Q=XW_Q, K=XW_K and V=XW_V. Dot product qᵢ·kⱼ scores how much token i should attend to j; divide by √d_k to control magnitude, apply softmax rowwise, and use the result to weight value vectors. A simple example q=(1,0), k₁=(1,0), k₂=(0,1), d_k=2 gives scores (0.707,0), weights (0.67,0.33).

If values are 2 and 8, output≈3.98. In multi-head attention each head learns its own projections; concatenate head outputs and apply W_O. Heads can attend to syntax, nearby positions or other patterns, but visualized attention alone is not a complete causal explanation.

The n×n score matrix explains the quadratic pairwise cost. In causal attention set future scores to −∞ before softmax; training can still compute all positions in parallel with shifted labels.

输入矩阵 X（n 个 token × d_model）形成 Q=XW_Q、K=XW_K、V=XW_V。点积 qᵢ·kⱼ 给出 i 对 j 的注意分数，除以 √d_k 控制大小，逐行 softmax 后加权 value。例 q=(1,0)、k₁=(1,0)、k₂=(0,1)、d_k=2，分数 (0.707,0)、权重 (0.67,0.33)；值 2、8 时输出≈3.98。

多头注意力各自学习投影，拼接后乘 W_O。不同头可关注句法或附近位置等，但注意力可视化不构成完整因果解释。n×n 分数矩阵说明二次方成对计算成本。因果注意力在 softmax 前将未来分数置为 −∞；训练仍可用移位标签同时计算所有位置。

For T tokens, Q and K of shape T×d_k yield a T×T score matrix; each row belongs to one query and each column to one key. Scale scores by √d_k, mask forbidden entries before softmax, and normalize along each query row. Multiplying the result by V of shape T×d_v returns T×d_v outputs.

Example: row scores (0,ln 3) give weights (0.25,0.75); value vectors (2,0) and (0,4) yield (0.5,3). Multi-head attention learns different projections, concatenates heads, then applies an output projection.

T 个 token 时，形状 T×d_k 的 Q 与 K 得到 T×T 分数矩阵，每行对应 query、每列对应 key。除 √d_k，softmax 前掩蔽禁用项，再逐行归一化。乘 T×d_v 的 V 得 T×d_v 输出。例如行分数 (0,ln 3) 对应权重 (0.25,0.75)，value (2,0) 与 (0,4) 得 (0.5,3)。

多头学习不同投影，拼接各头再输出投影。

One attention row一行 attention 计算

1

Exponentiate and normalize within this query row.对本 query 行取指数后归一化。

2

Weight the two value vectors, not the keys.加权两个 value，不是 key。

3

The output is a vector of value dimension.输出维度与 value 相同。

Layers, normalization & training层结构、归一化与训练

Each Transformer layer combines attention, residual connections, normalization and position-wise FFN (two linear maps with nonlinearity). Original BERT-style post-norm normalizes after residual; GPT-style pre-norm normalizes before sublayer; exact architectures vary. LayerNorm normalizes features within one token, unlike BN's batch statistics.

BERT pretraining: masked language modeling (MLM) and original next sentence prediction (NSP); fine-tune token or [CLS] heads for tagging, QA and classification. GPT next-token CE learns all positions in parallel under causal mask; generation is autoregressive one token at a time. Induction heads and cooperating heads are observed mechanisms, not universal assigned functions.

Transformer 层组合注意力、残差、归一化和逐位置 FFN（两线性映射加非线性）。原始 BERT 式 post-norm 在残差后归一化；GPT 式 pre-norm 在子层前归一化；具体架构不同。LayerNorm 在单 token 特征内归一化，不同于 BN 的批统计。

BERT 预训练：MLM 掩码语言模型与原始 NSP 下一句预测；微调 token 或 [CLS] 头用于标注、问答和分类。GPT 在因果掩码下并行学习各位置下一 token CE；生成逐 token 自回归。Induction heads 与头之间协作是观察到的机制，非通用固定分工。

Key equation核心公式

Each Transformer layer alternates attention and a positionwise FFN (linear → activation → linear), with residual paths and LayerNorm. LayerNorm normalizes features within a token, unlike BatchNorm across examples. Original paper uses post-norm; many newer models use pre-norm to improve optimization.

Encoder attention sees both sides; decoder masked attention sees only the prefix. The GPT output head maps hidden states to vocabulary logits; during training compare every position with the next token. At inference select/sample one token, append it, repeat; a KV cache reuses past key/value projections but still grows with sequence length.

Temperature and top-k/top-p affect sampling rather than learned weights. Fine-tuning can attach a task head, adapt all weights, or use parameter-efficient adaptation. The slides contrast BERT-based classification/tagging with GPT generation and instruction tasks.

Transformer 层交替注意力和逐位置 FFN（线性→激活→线性），配残差路径与 LayerNorm。LayerNorm 在单 token 的特征间归一化，不同于跨样本 BN。原论文用 post-norm，许多新模型用 pre-norm 改善优化。Encoder 看两侧，Decoder 掩码只看前缀。GPT 输出头将隐藏状态映射为词表 logits；训练中每个位置与下一 token 比较。

推理时选择/采样一个 token、追加、重复；KV cache 复用过去 key/value 投影，却仍随长度增长。温度、top-k/top-p 改变采样而不是权重。微调可添加任务头、调整全部参数或参数高效适配。课件对比 BERT 分类/标注与 GPT 生成、指令任务。

A Transformer layer contains two conceptually different operations: attention moves information among token positions, while the feedforward network applies the same learned nonlinear mapping independently at each position. Residual additions retain paths from the input; normalization controls activation scale.

Pre-norm and post-norm differ in where normalization is placed, so do not mix equations. During GPT training, the ground-truth sequence provides parallel inputs and shifted labels, but the causal mask prevents information leakage from future tokens.

Transformer 层有两种不同运算：attention 在 token 位置间传递信息，FFN 对每个位置独立应用同一学习非线性映射。残差加法保留输入路径，归一化控制激活尺度。Pre-norm 和 post-norm 的归一化位置不同，不要混用。

GPT 训练可使用真实序列并行输入与错位标签，但因果掩码阻止未来 token 信息泄漏。

Original encoder–decoder & efficient attention原始编码器-解码器与高效注意力

Original translation Transformer: source embeddings plus sinusoidal positions; encoder unmasked self-attention; decoder shifted targets, causal self-attention then cross-attention over source, FFN and output softmax. Teacher-forced training parallel, inference sequential. Full self-attention has O(n²d) attention cost and O(n²) score size; recurrence has sequential O(n) path vs direct attention's short paths.

Sparse/local/sliding-window attention restricts pairs (may miss remote details); learned sparsity selects pairs. FlashAttention computes exact softmax attention in tiles with reduced memory traffic, not linear arithmetic complexity. Linear attention changes feature/normalization formulation to reassociate products and reduce length dependence, with quality trade-offs.

原始翻译 Transformer：源嵌入加正弦位置；编码器无掩码自注意力；解码器目标右移、因果自注意力、对源序列交叉注意力，再 FFN 与输出 softmax。Teacher forcing 训练并行，推理顺序。完整自注意力计算 O(n²d)，分数矩阵 O(n²)；循环路径 O(n) 而直接注意力路径短。

稀疏/局部/滑窗注意力限制配对（可能漏远程细节），学习稀疏选择配对。FlashAttention 分块精确计算 softmax 注意力、减少显存访问，并不将算术复杂度变线性。线性注意力修改特征/归一化以重排乘法，降低长度依赖但有质量权衡。

In encoder–decoder cross-attention, queries originate from decoder states, keys and values from the encoder output. The decoder has both causal self-attention and cross-attention. During teacher-forced training the shifted target sequence is available, enabling parallel computation; at inference the previous output must be generated first.

The original paper compares full attention O(n²d), recurrence O(nd²) and convolution: self-attention has a short path between arbitrary positions and parallel training, but quadratic attention costs matter for long sequences.

Local/sliding-window attention limits each query to w neighbours (roughly O(nw)), sparse attention uses selected positions, and efficient implementations such as FlashAttention reduce memory traffic without changing exact full-attention semantics. Linear attention changes the computation/approximation to avoid materializing all pairs; distinguish speed improvements from changes in what can be retrieved.

Encoder–decoder 的 cross-attention 中 query 来自 decoder，key/value 来自 encoder 输出。Decoder 同时有因果自注意力与交叉注意力。Teacher-forcing 训练时已知移位目标序列，可并行；推理必须先生成前一输出。

原论文对比全注意力 O(n²d)、循环 O(nd²) 与卷积：自注意力任意位置之间路径短、训练并行，但长序列二次成本显著。

局部/滑动窗口注意力每个 query 只看 w 个邻居（约 O(nw)），稀疏注意力选部分位置；FlashAttention 等高效实现减少内存读写而不改变精确全注意力语义。线性注意力改变计算或近似方式，避免完整成对矩阵；区分加速与可检索信息的变化。

Cross-attention is different from self-attention: queries originate in the decoder while keys and values originate in the encoder. Thus target positions can retrieve information from all source positions without seeing future target tokens.

Dense self-attention forms T² scores, making long sequences expensive. Sparse/local attention restricts the allowed pairs; FlashAttention-style implementations reduce memory traffic for exact attention without necessarily reducing its arithmetic complexity.

KV caching reuses past keys and values during decoding.

Cross-attention 区别于 self-attention：query 来自 decoder，key 与 value 来自 encoder。目标位置可检索全部源位置，但不看未来目标 token。稠密 self-attention 形成 T² 分数，长序列成本高。

稀疏/局部注意力限制允许的配对；FlashAttention 类实现降低精确 attention 内存流量，不必然降低算术复杂度。KV cache 在解码时复用过去 key/value。

State-space models, Mamba & selection状态空间模型、Mamba 与选择机制

SSM evolves a hidden state by linear recurrence and reads output; discretization step Δ controls timescale. Mamba's selective SSM makes Δ, B, C input-dependent, allowing selective remembering/forgetting; unlike ordinary fixed-parameter SSM. Block components in slides: RMSNorm, input projection, short causal Conv1d, SiLU, selective scan, gating and output projection.

Linear-time sequence scan and bounded recurrent inference state are attractive for long context; compressed state can lose exact distant details versus explicit attention. Compare RNN/LSTM/GRU gates, SSM selection and Transformer token-to-token attention.

SSM 用线性递推演化隐藏状态并读出；离散步长 Δ 控制时间尺度。Mamba 选择性 SSM 使 Δ、B、C 依赖输入，能选择记忆/遗忘，不同于固定参数 SSM。课件模块：RMSNorm、输入投影、短因果 Conv1d、SiLU、选择性扫描、门控和输出投影。

线性长度扫描与有界循环推理状态适合长上下文；压缩状态相较显式注意力可能丢失远程精确细节。比较 RNN/LSTM/GRU 门、SSM 选择与 Transformer token 间注意力。

Key equation核心公式

An SSM summarizes a sequence through state updates hₜ=Āhₜ₋₁+B̄xₜ, yₜ=Chₜ. Continuous dynamics dh/dt=Ah+Bx can be discretized to this recurrence. With fixed coefficients it can also be expressed as a convolution; structured parameterization and parallel scan make training efficient. Mamba makes selection input-dependent (e.g.

B,C, step size Δ), allowing the model to retain important tokens and forget irrelevant ones. A recurrence that keeps h when seeing irrelevant text and writes when a delimiter appears is a simple analogy. Unlike full attention, the fixed-size state need not store every previous key/value; streaming inference can be linear in sequence length, but exact arbitrary-token retrieval is harder.

Compare with simple RNN, LSTM/GRU gating and Transformer: all model context, but differ in state representation, parallel training and memory cost.

SSM 通过状态更新 hₜ=Āhₜ₋₁+B̄xₜ、yₜ=Chₜ 概括序列；连续动态 dh/dt=Ah+Bx 可离散为该递推。固定系数也可表示为卷积；结构化参数与并行 scan 使训练高效。Mamba 使选择机制依赖输入（如 B、C、步长 Δ），保留重要 token、遗忘无关 token。

简单类比是递推在无关词时保持 h，在分隔符时写入。区别于全注意力，固定大小状态不需存储每个过去 key/value，流式推理对序列长度可线性，但精确检索任意 token 较困难。

简单 RNN、LSTM/GRU 门控、Transformer 都建模上下文，但状态表示、训练并行性与内存成本不同。

A state-space recurrence compresses history into a state rather than explicitly storing pairwise attention scores. In Mamba's selective mechanism, parts of the recurrence depend on the input, so the model can retain relevant information and suppress irrelevant tokens.

Parallel scan makes suitable recurrences efficient in training; sequential inference updates the state. Compared with dense attention, this can improve long-sequence scaling, but a fixed-size state is not identical to direct retrieval of all past token vectors.

状态空间递推将历史压缩进状态，而非显式保存两两注意力分数。Mamba 的选择机制使部分递推系数依赖输入，从而保留相关信息、抑制无关 token。合适的递推可通过 parallel scan 加速训练，推理则逐步更新状态。相比稠密 attention 可改善长序列扩展性，但固定大小状态不等同于直接检索全部历史 token 向量。

MoE & hybrid architectures混合专家与混合架构

Mixture of experts (MoE) replaces dense FFN with several experts and a learned router selecting top-k per token; many total parameters but only selected experts active, with routing/load-balancing overhead. Hybrid models combine selective/recurrent/linear layers with occasional attention for efficient memory plus exact retrieval.

Slides: Jamba (SSM + attention), Griffin (gated recurrence + local attention), Hymba (attention/SSM heads), Kimi Linear, Nemotron 3 Super. Distinguish hybrid architecture from MoE (layer types versus conditional expert computation).

混合专家（MoE）用多个专家替代稠密 FFN，学习路由器为每 token 选 top-k；总参数多、仅部分激活，但有路由和负载均衡开销。混合模型将选择性/循环/线性层和少量注意力结合，实现高效记忆与精确检索。课件例子：Jamba（SSM+注意力）、Griffin（门控循环+局部注意力）、Hymba（注意力/SSM 头）、Kimi Linear、Nemotron 3 Super。

混合架构是层类型组合，MoE 是条件专家计算。

Mixture of experts replaces a dense FFN with several expert FFNs and a router that chooses top-k experts for each token; attention can remain shared. With 16 equal experts and top-2 routing, only 2/16=12.5% of expert weights are activated per token, not 12.5% of the entire network. Load-balancing objectives prevent all tokens being routed to a few experts; expert parallelism adds communication overhead.

Hybrid systems mix complementary mechanisms: Jamba alternates Mamba and attention, Griffin combines gated recurrence with local attention, Hymba uses parallel attention/SSM heads, Kimi Linear and Nemotron are examples in the slides.

Attention can retrieve exact past positions while recurrent/SSM layers maintain compressed context. Sliding windows bound attention cost but may miss distant information unless other layers preserve it. The lecture contrasts total and active parameter counts, a critical distinction in sparse models.

MoE 用多个专家 FFN 代替稠密 FFN，router 为每个 token 选 top-k 专家；注意力可保持共享。16 个等大专家、top-2 时，每 token 激活专家权重的 2/16=12.5%，并非整个网络的 12.5%。负载均衡目标避免集中路由；专家并行增加通信开销。

混合模型结合互补机制：课件中的 Jamba 交替 Mamba 和注意力，Griffin 结合门控递推与局部注意力，Hymba 并列注意力与 SSM 头，Kimi Linear、Nemotron 也是例子。

注意力可精确检索过去位置，递推/SSM 压缩上下文。滑动窗口限制成本，但若其他层未保留远处信息，可能遗漏。稀疏模型必须区分总参数与激活参数。

In an MoE layer, a router scores experts and selects a small subset per token. With eight equal experts and top-2 routing, the model holds eight expert parameter sets but evaluates only two for that token (plus routing and shared layers).

This separates total parameter capacity from active compute. Load balancing matters because routing all tokens to one expert wastes capacity and creates a bottleneck. Hybrid models combine different sequence mixers, e.g. attention and SSM blocks, to trade retrieval quality against compute and memory.

MoE 层由 router 给专家打分，每个 token 选少量专家。8 个等大专家、top-2 路由时，模型保有 8 组参数，但该 token 只计算 2 个（另含路由与共享层）。这分离总参数容量和激活计算量。负载均衡重要：全部 token 进一个专家会浪费容量并造成瓶颈。

混合模型结合不同序列混合器，例如 attention 与 SSM，以平衡检索质量、算力和内存。

Diffusion language models, RoPE & RAG扩散语言模型、RoPE 与 RAG

Diffusion learns to reverse progressive corruption/noise; image diffusion starts from noise, text diffusion can start with all [MASK] and iteratively predict/unmask confident tokens, potentially filling multiple positions in parallel; not the same as GPT's left-to-right generation. RoPE rotates Q/K so dot products encode relative position.

Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) retrieves relevant external passages before generation (retrieval, context injection, answer); improves access to facts but depends on retrieval quality and does not update model weights. Slides survey 2025–26 examples as lecture context, not current benchmarks.

扩散学习逆转逐步污染/噪声；图像扩散从噪声开始，文本扩散可从全 [MASK] 开始迭代预测并解除高置信掩码，可并行填多个位置；不同于 GPT 从左到右生成。RoPE 旋转 Q/K，使点积编码相对位置。检索增强生成（RAG）在生成前检索外部相关段落（检索、注入上下文、回答）；改善事实获取但依赖检索质量，不更新模型权重。课件的 2025–26 例子为教学背景，非实时性能排名。

Diffusion models learn to reverse a corruption process. Image DDPM progressively adds Gaussian noise and trains a denoiser; sampling starts with noise and iteratively removes it. Latent diffusion applies this in a compressed latent space and decodes to pixels. Discrete text diffusion (D3PM-style) masks/replaces tokens instead of adding real-valued noise; LLaDA-like sampling starts from masks and fills several positions per denoising step, revising uncertain ones.

Parallel filling can improve throughput but depends on denoising steps and quality; autoregressive decoding instead commits left-to-right.

RoPE rotates pairs of query/key components by position-dependent angles, so their dot product depends on relative position j−i. It is not a learned document database. RAG builds a document passage index (embedding vectors), embeds a query, retrieves similar passages (e.g. cosine), and supplies them as context to a generator; it can update knowledge without retraining the generator, but retrieval errors remain.

The course closes with sparse/hybrid/alternative-generation research trends; use named models as illustrations of architecture rather than memorizing release-date benchmarks.

扩散模型学习逆转破坏过程。图像 DDPM 逐步加入高斯噪声并训练去噪器；采样从噪声开始迭代去除。隐空间扩散在压缩 latent 中完成后解码为像素。离散文本扩散（D3PM 等）掩码/替换 token 而非加入连续噪声；LLaDA 式生成从掩码开始，每步填充多个位置并修正不确定项。

并行填充可能加速，但取决于去噪步数和质量；自回归则从左到右确定输出。RoPE 按位置角度旋转成对 query/key 分量，使点积依赖相对位置 j−i；不是文档数据库。

RAG 建立文档段落的嵌入索引，对问题编码、检索相似段落（例如余弦相似度），作为生成器上下文；无需重训生成器即可更新资料，但检索仍会出错。课程最后讨论稀疏、混合及替代生成研究趋势，模型名称用于理解架构，不必死记发布日期基准。

Autoregressive generation commits tokens in order; diffusion language models iteratively refine a partially corrupted or masked sequence and may revise several positions per step. RoPE rotates query/key coordinate pairs by positions, so dot products depend on relative offsets.

RAG retrieves relevant external documents and conditions the generator on them; it does not by itself update the model's weights. Retrieval can fail or return irrelevant passages, so the final output still needs evidence checking.

自回归生成按序提交 token；扩散语言模型迭代改进被扰动或掩码的序列，每步可能修订多个位置。RoPE 根据位置旋转 query/key 坐标对，使点积依赖相对偏移。RAG 检索外部文档并将其作为生成条件，并不会自行更新模型权重。检索可能失败或返回无关段落，最终输出仍需核对证据。

1 分：cross-attention Q 来自解码器，K/V 来自编码器，以源序列为条件。
Numerical answer数值填空
A1.For one query, scaled attention scores are (0,0,0), and scalar values are (1,2,6). What is the attention output?某查询的缩放注意力分数为 (0,0,0)，标量 values 为 (1,2,6)。求注意力输出。
Softmax gives uniform weights 1/3, so output=(1+2+6)/3=3.softmax 权重均为 1/3，输出为 3。
Multi-step calculation多步计算题 · 5 marks5 分
A2.A Transformer receives 128 tokens of dimension 512, with 8 heads of dimension 64. Give Q,K,V shapes per head (ignore batch), score matrix shape per head and concatenated head output shape. Explain why causal masking is applied before softmax.Transformer 输入 128 个 512 维 token，8 个 64 维头。给出每头 Q,K,V 形状、分数矩阵形状及拼接后形状（忽略 batch）。解释因果掩码为何在 softmax 前使用。
[5 marks] Q,K,V each 128×64; QKᵀ is 128×128. Each head output 128×64; concatenation 128×512. Mask future logits with −∞ before softmax so their probability is zero and allowed weights renormalize.[5 分] Q,K,V 各为 128×64；QKᵀ 为 128×128；每头输出 128×64，拼接 128×512。softmax 前未来 logit 置为 −∞，令其概率为零且合法权重重新归一化。
Multiple select多选题
A3.For dense self-attention on n tokens and fixed head dimension, which statements are correct? Select all.固定头维度、n 个 token 的密集自注意力，哪些陈述正确？多选。
Select every correct option. More than one is correct.选择所有正确选项，答案不止一个。
A. Correct正确 Each query compares with every key.每个 query 与每个 key 比较。
B. Incorrect错误 Its IO-aware tiling can compute exact attention without materializing the full score matrix.其 IO 感知分块可精确计算注意力，不必物化完整分数矩阵。
C. Correct正确 Content-only unmasked attention has no inherent absolute order.仅内容的无掩码注意力无固有绝对顺序。
D. Incorrect错误 Caching saves repeated computation during decoding, not all prefill work.缓存节约解码时重复计算，并不消除 prefill。
Short answer简答题 · 4 marks4 分
A4.Compare standard attention, selective state-space models (Mamba), and MoE in terms of what they change. Why is an MoE router not a replacement for token mixing by itself?比较标准注意力、选择性状态空间模型（Mamba）及 MoE 分别改变什么；为什么 MoE 路由本身不能取代 token 混合？
[4 marks] Attention mixes tokens via query–key similarities; selective SSMs carry recurrent state with input-dependent dynamics, supporting efficient sequential/scan computation. MoE routes token representations to a subset of feed-forward experts to increase parameter capacity with sparse compute. Routing chooses experts; cross-token information still needs a mixing mechanism.[4 分] 注意力通过 query–key 相似度混合 token；选择性 SSM 以输入相关动态维护循环状态，支持高效顺序/扫描计算。MoE 将 token 路由到部分前馈专家，以稀疏计算扩大容量。路由选择专家，跨 token 信息仍需要混合机制。
Numerical answer数值填空
A5.An MoE layer has 8 equally sized experts, each with 10 million parameters, top-2 routing per token. Ignoring router and shared layers, what fraction of total expert parameters (in units of 10 million) is active per token? Enter the number of 10-million units.MoE 有 8 个等大专家，每个 1000 万参数，每 token top-2 路由。忽略路由器和共享层，每 token 激活多少个“1000 万参数”单位？
2 experts ×10 million=20 million, i.e. 2 units (25% of 80 million total expert parameters).2 个专家 ×1000 万=2000 万，即 2 单位（总专家参数 8000 万的 25%）。
Numerical answer数值填空
A6.At token 2 of a causal attention head (positions 1,2,3), the scaled logits before masking are (ln2,0,ln4). Scalar values are (6,3,20). Compute the attention output at token 2.因果注意力头位置 2（位置 1,2,3）的掩码前缩放 logits 为 (ln2,0,ln4)，标量 values 为 (6,3,20)。求位置 2 的注意力输出。
Mask position 3 before softmax. Allowed exponentials are 2 and 1, weights 2/3 and 1/3. Output=(2×6+3)/3=5. Value 20 makes no contribution.softmax 前屏蔽位置 3；合法指数为 2、1，权重 2/3、1/3；输出 (2×6+3)/3=5，20 无贡献。
Numerical answer数值填空
A7.A simple scalar state-space recurrence is hₜ=0.5hₜ₋₁+2xₜ with h₀=0. Inputs are x₁=1,x₂=0.5,x₃=1.125. Compute h₃.简单标量状态空间递推 hₜ=0.5hₜ₋₁+2xₜ，h₀=0，输入 x₁=1,x₂=0.5,x₃=1.125，求 h₃。
h₁=2; h₂=1+1=2; h₃=1+2.25=3.25.h₁=2；h₂=2；h₃=3.25。
Short answer简答题 · 4 marks4 分
A8.A language model answers a question about a newly published document that was not in its training corpus. Compare RAG and weight fine-tuning for incorporating the new information. Why can neither retrieval nor generation alone guarantee factual correctness?语言模型回答关于训练语料中未包含的新发布文档的问题。比较 RAG 与权重微调如何引入新信息。为何仅检索或仅生成都不能保证事实正确？
[4 marks] RAG retrieves relevant passages and conditions generation on them without necessarily changing weights; updating the index can add new information quickly. Fine-tuning changes weights and requires training, but does not guarantee precise recall. Retrieval may return irrelevant or incomplete evidence; the generator can misinterpret or ignore it. Grounded citation/verification matters.[4 分] RAG 检索相关段落，作为生成条件，不必修改权重；更新索引可快速加入新信息。微调改变权重、需训练，且不保证精确记忆。检索可能返回无关或不全证据，生成器可能误读或忽略，需来源依据与核验。
Multiple select多选题
A9.Which statements about decoder-only autoregressive models and masked/diffusion-style language generation are defensible? Select all.关于 decoder-only 自回归模型与掩码/扩散式语言生成，哪些陈述成立？多选。
Select every correct option. More than one is correct.选择所有正确选项，答案不止一个。
A. Incorrect错误 Future ground truth is unavailable in inference.推理时未来真值不可用。
B. Correct正确 The chain rule gives a product over causal prefixes.链式法则得到依赖因果前缀的乘积。
C. Incorrect错误 Iterative denoising/refinement can revise multiple positions.迭代去噪/细化可修改多个位置。
D. Correct正确 Different positions can be filled or revised over refinement steps.不同位置可在细化步骤中填充或修改。
Foundation practice基础练习
1.Why divide attention logits by √dₖ?为什么注意力分数除以 √dₖ？
Scaling controls magnitude; positions and masking are separate operations and weights still differ.缩放控制分数幅度；位置与掩码是独立操作，权重仍可不同。
2.Scaled scores (0,0), values (4,10). Attention output?缩放分数 (0,0)，value (4,10)，注意力输出？
Equal logits yield equal weights 0.5, so average is 7.相同分数产生各 0.5 权重，均值为 7。
3.What does a causal attention mask prevent?因果注意力 mask 防止什么？
It blocks future positions only; past context and projections remain.只屏蔽未来位置，过去上下文与投影仍然存在。
4.Which model is normally trained by masked-token prediction with bidirectional context?哪个模型通常使用双向上下文预测掩码 token？
BERT learns masked inputs with both directions; GPT is next-token causal and the others are unrelated.BERT 从双向输入预测掩码；GPT 因果预测下一 token，其他无关。
5.Doubling sequence length makes full attention score count approximately?序列长度翻倍，完整注意力分数数目约变成？
Pairwise T×T scales quadratically; the other ratios are incorrect.T×T 成对分数为平方增长。
6.What distinguishes Mamba from standard fixed-parameter linear SSMs?Mamba 与标准固定参数线性 SSM 的主要区别？
Selection adapts state retention to tokens without full pairwise attention; it still has state and handles sequences.选择机制随 token 调节状态记忆，不需要完整成对注意力，但仍有状态并处理序列。
7.MoE top-2 routing among 16 experts means?16 个专家的 MoE 使用 top-2 路由意味着？
Sparse expert activation differs from total parameter count and attention heads.稀疏激活不同于总参数数，也不同于注意力头。
8.RAG primarily does what at inference?RAG 推理时主要做什么？
Retrieval conditions generation without necessarily training the model; it is not RL or weight updating.检索改变生成条件，不一定训练模型；不是 RL 或权重更新。
9.In encoder–decoder cross-attention, where do keys and values normally come from?编码器–解码器交叉注意力中，key 与 value 通常来自哪里？
Decoder queries retrieve information from encoder keys/values; masked decoder self-attention is separate.解码器 query 从编码器 key/value 检索信息；掩码解码器自注意力是另一运算。
10.What is the purpose of positional encoding in a Transformer?Transformer 位置编码目的？
Unmasked self-attention without positions is permutation-equivariant; positional cues distinguish order.无位置的无掩码自注意力排列等变；位置线索区分顺序。
11.Which normalization is typical inside Transformer layers?Transformer 层内典型归一化？
LayerNorm normalizes within a feature vector, unlike batch statistics.LayerNorm 在特征向量内归一化，区别于 batch 统计。
12.What does a KV cache store?KV cache 存什么？
Past K/V projections can be reused; future tokens remain unknown.可复用历史 K/V 投影；未来词仍未知。
13.A 1,000-token full-attention layer uses how many score entries per head, ignoring mask savings?1000 token 全注意力每头分数项（忽略掩码节省）？
Each token compares with every token, n²=1e6.每词与每词比较，n²=1e6。
14.Why combine SSM layers with attention in a hybrid?为何混合 SSM 与注意力？
Complementary memory mechanisms can trade compute for detailed retrieval; the other options are false guarantees.互补记忆机制权衡计算和细节检索，其他为错误保证。
15.What is the corruption process in masked text diffusion?掩码文本扩散的破坏过程？
Discrete tokens require a discrete corruption process; generation learns to reverse it.离散词需要离散破坏，生成学逆转。
16.Which vectors does RoPE rotate?RoPE 旋转哪些向量？
Position-dependent rotations modify Q/K dot products to encode relative position.位置相关旋转修改 Q/K 点积以编码相对位置。
